links.snippet: Damnation feats represent a bargain the character has made with some dark power, granting the character great power at the cost of her eternal soul. Damnation feats are distinct from more common feats in three ways.

links.title: Caravan Feats
links.snippet: A caravan has a number of feats equal to its level. When you first gain access to a caravan, you as a party may pick the caravan’s first feat from the list of caravan feats—provided that the caravan qualifies for the feat, of course!

links.title: Local Feats
links.snippet: Local feats are optional additional feats available in various setting books. Each feat is tied to a specific area of the world and are meant to allow PC’s to display a variety of innate skills and unique talents of their native land.

links.snippet: The Iconic Druid is an empathetic gnome with a talent for calming angry animals. Her nature bond class ability is with her snow leopard (small cat).

links.title: Iconic Ranger
links.snippet: The Iconic Ranger is a gruff and driven dwarf, following a vow of justice to avenge his brother’s death at the hands of giants. He prefers tea to ale, wanting to keep his senses sharp.

links.title: Aberrations
links.snippet: An aberration has a bizarre anatomy, strange abilities, an alien mindset, or any combination of the three.

links.title: Animals
links.snippet: An animal is a living, nonhuman creature, usually a vertebrate with no magical abilities and no innate capacity for language or culture. Animals usually have additional information on how they can serve as companions.

links.title: Monstrous Humanoids
links.snippet: Monstrous humanoids are similar to humanoids, but with monstrous or animalistic features. They often have magical abilities as well.

links.title: Oozes

links.snippet: Benefit : When a crystal chakram strikes a foe, the weapon shatters into tiny sharp fragments; if it misses, there is a 50% chance the chakram shatters when it hits the ground or another solid object; otherwise it can be retrieved and used…

links.title: Double Walking Stick Katana
links.snippet: This single case conceals a pair of matched fighting swords perfectly balanced to be wielded as a pair. Despite their name, the blades more closely resemble the shorter wakizashi.

links.title: Terbutje, Great
links.snippet: This 4-foot-long version of the terbutje is too large to use in one hand without special training.

links.title: Broadsword, Nine-Ring
links.snippet: This broad-bladed weapon has nine heavy rings threaded through its spine, providing additional weight to add to the force of its impressive chopping power.

links.title: Sword, Seven-Branched
links.snippet: This unusual sword has a straight 2-foot-long blade with six shorter L-shaped blades protruding, three on each side in a staggered pattern.

links.title: Sword, Butterfly
links.snippet: These short matching swords come in pairs, cleverly nested together to appear as a single blade.

links.title: Madu
links.snippet: The madu is a round, light shield with two animal horns—usually from an antelope—extending from opposite sides of the shield.

links.title: Shield, Heavy; Wooden or Steel
links.snippet: Wooden or Steel : Wooden and steel shields offer the same basic protection, though they respond differently to spells and effects.

links.title: Shield, Light; Wooden or Steel
links.snippet: Wooden or Steel : Wooden and steel shields offer the same basic protection, though they respond differently to some spells and effects.

links.title: Dart, Wushu
links.snippet: Benefit : This sharpened wooden spike can be used as a punching weapon but it is perfectly balanced for throwing.

links.title: Staff, Bo
links.snippet: Similar to a quarterstaff, only slightly more slender and tapered at one end, the bo staff is both a defensive device and a weapon.

links.title: Monk’s Spade
links.snippet: This weapon is a double weapon pole arm. One side is fitted with a broad, shovel-like sharpened blade while the opposite side is fitted with a crescent blade that juts out like a pair of bull’s horns.

links.title: Kama, Double-Chained
links.snippet: This weapon comprises a pair of kama connected with an 8-foot length of chain.

links.title: Whip, Nine-Section
links.snippet: The nine-section whip consists of steel bars linked together. The final bar is a 6-inch weighted spike.

links.title: Sansetsukon (Three-Section Staff)
links.snippet: This staff is broken into three 2-foot-long segments that have been chained back together, allowing the wielder greater flexibility, and allows the weapon to be swung rapidly to create a defensive block.

links.title: Sword, Tri-Point Double-Edged
links.snippet: Topping the head of this 5-foot-long shaft are three long, backward-curved blades fashioned in the appearance of a blossoming lotus. The unusually large head is designed to land heavy blows and multiple wounds that open away from each…

links.title: Lance, Hooked
links.snippet: This slender, 10-foot-long polearm has an added hook protruding from the head that is used to snag the clothing and armor of opponents.

links.title: Armor Mastery Feats
links.snippet: Armor mastery feats are a new type of feat that require armor training as a prerequisite. They count as combat feats for all purposes, including which classes can select them as bonus feats. You gain the benefits of an armor mastery feat…

links.title: Staggering Drunk (Ex)
links.snippet: Benefit : While raging, a barbarian gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity for each alcoholic drink she has consumed during her rage, to a maximum of +1 per four barbarian levels.

links.title: Strength Surge (Ex)
links.snippet: Benefit : The barbarian adds her barbarian level on one Strength check or combat maneuver check, or to her Combat Maneuver Defense when an opponent attempts a maneuver against her. This power is used as an immediate action .

links.title: Sunder Enchantment (Su)
links.snippet: Prerequisite : Barbarian 8, spell sunder rage power

links.title: Terrifying Howl (Ex)
links.snippet: Prerequisite : Barbarian 8, intimidating glare rage power

links.title: Ultimate Clarity (Su)
links.snippet: Prerequisite(s) : Barbarian 6, moment of clarity , perfect clarity

links.title: Unexpected Strike (Ex)
links.snippet: Benefit : The barbarian can make an attack of opportunity against a foe that moves into any square threatened by the barbarian, regardless of whether or not that movement would normally provoke an attack of opportunity .

links.title: Water Sense (Ex)
links.snippet: Your senses are no longer fooled by the rippling surface and confounding reflections seen in water that is being used as cover by your foes.

links.title: World Serpent Totem (Su)
links.snippet: Note : Totem rage powers grant powers related to a theme. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a beast totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the dragon…

links.snippet: Prerequisite : Barbarian 6, world serpent totem rage power

links.snippet: Prerequisite : Barbarian 6, lesser lunar totem rage power

links.title: Death Totem, Lesser (Ex)
links.snippet: Benefit(s) : While raging , the barbarian gains DR 5/ bludgeoning and a +2 resistance bonus against cold-based spells and effects.

links.title: Death Totem, Greater (Ex)
links.snippet: Prerequisite(s) : Barbarian or savage 12, lesser death totem and death totem rage powers

links.title: Raging Skald (Ex)
links.snippet: Prerequisite(s) : A barbarian must be at least 6th level before selecting this rage power.

links.title: Improved Totemic Alignment (Su)
links.snippet: Prerequisite : Barbarian 6, must possess the totemic sage archetype .

links.title: Totemic Mettle (Su)
links.snippet: Prerequisite : Must possess the totemic sage archetype .

links.title: Ancients’ Flight (Oratory)
links.snippet: You compel dragons to recite an epic poem telling the story of their race’s creation.

links.title: At the Heart of It All (String, Wind)
links.snippet: Your song pierces to the heart of a creature’s identity, weakening it against you.

links.title: The Canticle of Joy (Sing)
links.snippet: Your haunting melody is capable of shattering the very minds of those who hear it.

links.title: The Cat-Step (Dance)
links.snippet: Your agile dancing allows you and others to fall safely and land gracefully.

links.title: Clamor Of the Heavens (Percussion, Sing)
links.snippet: This confusing dirge of melody and counter-melody was composed for choirs celebrating various martyrs. It is intended to praise and magnify the glory of the lords, but to the uninitiated it sounds like a battle hymn.

links.title: The Dance of 23 Steps (Dance)
links.snippet: This complex dance makes you difficult to strike.

links.title: The Dance of Kindled Desires (Dance)
links.snippet: Each sway and shake of your hips calls up another temptation from the depths of Hell until your spectator, hapless and drooling, finally succumbs and freely offers up his life, honor, or very soul for just a taste of what you have…

links.title: The Depths of the Mountain (Percussion, Wind)
links.snippet: Your drumming skills can break solid rock.

links.title: The Dragon and the First King (String, Wind)
links.snippet: You affect the mood of listeners by celebrating the defeat of the father of all dragons.

links.title: The Dumbshow of Gorroc (Act, Comedy)
links.snippet: Your acting conjures hellfire and salt to destroy plants.

links.title: The House of the Imaginary Walls (Act)
links.snippet: You can trap opponents with the power of your acting.

links.title: Illusion’s Decree (Comedy, Oratory)
links.snippet: These stories of wiliness and mystery inspire listeners to see through deceptions.

links.title: Legato Piece on the Infernal Bargain (String)
links.snippet: Your skilled playing can conjure up supernatural servants.

links.title: Life Budding In Salted Earth (Sing, String, Wind)
links.snippet: This delicate tune suggests the determined sprouting of seedlings through barren, rocky soil.

links.title: The Lullaby of Ember the Ancient (Sing)
links.snippet: You can put powerful creatures to sleep with the power of your song.

links.title: Melody of Frightful Death (String)
links.snippet: The pain and horror of the Abyss shrieks through your instrument to make a listener experience the death she dreads most.

links.title: Minuet of the Midnight Ivy (Dance)
links.snippet: Your winding, twisting dance is helpful in dodging obstacles and climbing.

links.title: Pageant of the Peacock (Act, Dance)
links.snippet: Your elegant movements cause you to seem to be more than you are.

links.title: Pallavi of Nirvana’s Blossoming (Dance)
links.snippet: The divine sunlight caused by this dance banishes darkness and causes flowers to bloom.

links.title: The Quickening Pulse (Percussion, Wind)
links.snippet: Your driving notes cause unnatural heart rates in your opponents.

links.title: Rat Quadrille (Percussion, Sing)
links.snippet: This repetitive, distracting melody wears down foes.

links.title: The Requiem of the Fallen Priest-King (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: Your performance reveals ways to cheat time itself.

links.title: The Rheumy Refrain (Sing)
links.snippet: Your strange melody of hacking gasps and pained wheezes draws upon the dark powers of Abaddon to fill a witness with debilitating and distracting phlegm.

links.title: Rondeau of Heavenly Order (Sing)
links.snippet: Your carefully structured song imposes rigid order on your listeners.

links.title: Stone Face (Comedy, Oratory)
links.snippet: Your antics can soften even the hardest visage.

links.title: Symphony of the Elysian Heart (Keyboard, Wind)
links.snippet: You spark notes of joy and freedom in your listeners.

links.title: Tales of Twisting Steel (Act, Oratory)
links.snippet: This medley of tales inspires listeners to new heights of bravery and self sacrifice.

links.title: Toccata and Fugue of the Danse Macabre (Keyboard, Wind)
links.snippet: Your spooky music blurs the boundaries between life and death, confusing the senses of undead creatures.

links.title: Triple Time (Percussion, String, Wind)
links.snippet: Your lively cadence puts a spring in the step of weary marchers.

links.title: Vindictive Soliloquy (Act, Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: Your bombastic speech creates booming reverberations of sound.

links.title: The Winds of the Five Heavens (Act, Oratory)
links.snippet: You control the wind by telling a tale demonstrating the hubris of mortals.

links.title: Anthem of Pageantry (String, Wind)
links.snippet: This lengthy piece gradually increases in power and gravity, conjuring magnificent furnishings and outfits out of thin air.

links.title: Arrowsong’s Lament (Oratory)
links.snippet: This collection of brooding poetry, all in pentatonic verse, provides great insight into reading and memorizing spells from a spellbook .

links.title: Ballad of the Homesick Wanderer (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: This poem of sadness and longing was developed by a bard seeking a way to fight summoned creatures without violence. Its otherworldly lyrics drive outsiders to return to their planes of origin.

links.title: Banshee’s Requiem (Sing)
links.snippet: By filling your performance with the mournful angst of a lost love, your song evokes the inexorable pull of the grave upon every living thing.

links.title: Battle Song of the People’s Revolt (Percussion, Wind)
links.snippet: This song for fife and drum is found in many folios filled with music intended to unite people.

links.title: Blazing Rondo
links.snippet: Thundering rhythms quicken your allies’ movements, but the effort of keeping up with the beat is wearying.

links.title: Dance of Captivating Desire (Dance)
links.snippet: This swaying, sensuous dance fans the fires of lust.

links.title: Dance of the Snake (Dance)
links.snippet: Your expressive dance makes your allies much more limber.

links.title: Dance of the Spiraling Ascent (Act, Dance)
links.snippet: You can hurl your allies into battle by directing swift winds.

links.title: Death of Heroes (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: You speak tales of helpless warriors watching their loved ones die.

links.title: Dirge of the Torn Sail (Sing, String)
links.snippet: Your ominous refrain warns away those who would trespass in your domain.

links.title: Endless Waltz of the Eldest (Dance, String)
links.snippet: This elegant but dizzyingly fast gnome waltz calls for rapidly changing roles inspired by the many faces that the legendary Eldest of the First World wear.

links.title: Exhilarating Prayer of Grace (Dance)
links.snippet: You lead your audience through a series of stretches and exercises designed to warm the muscles and increase blood circulation.

links.title: Hymn of Restorative Harmonics (Sing, Wind)
links.snippet: You perform a song of such beauty that it touches the soul of any who hear it, allowing them to recover from any adverse conditions.

links.title: Hymn of Sacred Lands (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: You cherish and love your home with such strength that your words weave protective magic around your dwelling.

links.title: Kaminari Drums (Percussion)
links.snippet: You beat a thunderous cacophony that strikes your foes with the fury of the kami of storms.

links.title: Lingering Leitmotif (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: Your clever turn of words or catchy musical jingle sticks in people’s heads long after they have heard it.

links.title: Melody of Surrender (Sing, Wind)
links.snippet: This gentle, relaxing tune makes its listeners calm and receptive.

links.title: Music Beyond The Spheres Dance Sing String
links.snippet: You use your own life force to create a phantasmagorical impression of eldritch vibrations with your wild, flailing dance and erratic tones. The performance unravels and remakes the fabric of reality around you according to your designs.

links.title: Night Queen’s Fury
links.snippet: You lay a curse on those who have wronged you.

links.title: Relentless Reprise Keyboard Sing String Wind
links.snippet: Your song replays endlessly in your target’s mind, sapping resolve and sanity.

links.title: Song of Defiance (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: You recite inspirational lines from this epic poem commemorating keeping defiance alive even in the face of certain death.

links.title: Song of the Stonebearers (Percussion, Sing)
links.snippet: This working song consists of a strong rhythm and bone-shaking drum beats.

links.title: Spirit of the Horse (Strings)
links.snippet: This mournful song empowers animal companions .

links.title: Stirring Discourse of the Mind (Oratory)
links.snippet: You lecture your audience on the merits of studious endeavors and inspire them with new insights into the subject matter. As a result of your discourse, those who listen become more receptive to knowledge.

links.title: Symphony of the Ascent (Percussion, Wind)
links.snippet: Prerequisite(s) : Perform (percussion or wind) 7 ranks.

links.title: Symphony of the Dark Prince
links.snippet: You contort your vocal cords to produce an eerie, melodious song about the wonders of Dispater’s court.

links.title: The Bear’s Jig (String, Wind)
links.snippet: Your music makes animals act like people.

links.title: The Sea Is Now My Sky (Sing, String)
links.snippet: Your thrilling tune causes you and your allies to fly through the water as easily as a bird soars through the air.

links.title: The Tragedy of False Hope (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: You remind those around you of how danger was ignored in expectation of a gods return.

links.title: Twilight’s Refuge (Dance, Oratory)
links.snippet: Prerequisite(s) : Perform (dance) 10 ranks or Perform (oratory) 10 ranks.

links.title: Wild Aria (Sing, Wind)
links.snippet: Channeling the mysterious power of the fey, you grant the listener the gift—or curse—of an animal’s shape.

links.title: Wildsoul Aria (Sing, Wind)
links.snippet: Channeling the mysterious power of the fey, you grant the listener the gift—or curse—of an animal’s shape.

links.title: Winter’s Refuge (Dance, Oratory)
links.snippet: Prerequisite : Perform (dance) 10 ranks or Perform (oratory) 10 ranks.

links.title: Wise King’s Saga (Oratory, Sing)
links.snippet: Your saga magically weaves the counsel of sagacious ancestors into the telling.

links.title: Fate Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : The god of fate’s touch has given you the ability to affect the fate of others, and to even change your own fate.

links.title: Gnome Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can grant others gnome -like resistances and increase your own racial abilities.

links.title: Halfling Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can grant others halfling -like luck and boost your own resistance to fear.

links.title: Ocean Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : The power of the god of oceans fills you, allowing you to soothe others with a touch, and preventing you from becoming sickened when traveling aboard a ship.

links.title: Orc Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can grant others orc-like abilities and boost your own ability to keep fighting even as you are dying .

links.title: Pleasure Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can grant others the glory of the pleasure god’s rapture with just a touch, and the pleasure god’s joy fills your heart to overflowing.

links.title: Renewal Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can grant others renewed strength with but a touch and restore life to yourself when you most need it.

links.title: Retribution Domain
links.snippet: Deity : Bast or other deities of revenge or vengeance, avengers of the wronged

links.title: Song Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : Your voice carries the power of the god of song and music, inspiring allies and charming foes.

links.title: Time domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : The god of time has given you the power to stop time briefly, and to shift backwards in time briefly as well.

links.title: Preservation Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : The will of the gods allows you to shake off any effect that would alter your mind or form.

links.title: Famine Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can inflict terrible suffering upon your foes by invoking the power of famine.

links.title: Electricity Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You can call forth bolts of electricity and withstand electricity’s destructive force.

links.title: Gunpowder Domain
links.snippet: Granted Powers : You are able to control the explosive potential of gunpowder and black powder , causing it to explode spectacularly or to fizzle harmlessly.

links.title: Steam Domain

links.title: Execution Inquisition
links.snippet: Your deity guides you when you deliver death to your chosen targets.

links.title: Fervor Inquisition
links.snippet: Only a passionate and righteous will such as yours can ensure that justice will be properly done.

links.title: Heresy Inquisition

links.title: Illumination Inquisition
links.snippet: Many times an inquisitor’s greatest weapon is pure and unflinching illumination; errors are often illuminated by light and wisdom.

links.title: Imprisonment Inquisition
links.snippet: Sometimes it is better to capture foes than to kill them—whether your intention is to punish them for their crimes or to torture them for information.

links.title: Justice Inquisition

links.title: Oblivion Inquisition

links.title: Politics Inquisition

links.title: Reformation Inquisition

links.snippet: Granted Powers : You are a healer, not just of people but also of sacred sites tainted by enemies of your faith.

links.title: Revelation Inquisition

links.title: Secrets Inquisition

links.title: Sedition Inquisition

links.title: Seduction Inquisition

links.title: Arrow, Blunt

links.snippet: This lizard-like creature stalks forward upon two muscular legs, a mane of spikes running down its scaly back.

links.title: Crayfish, Monstrous
links.snippet: This creature looks like a giant lobster with a sharp snout and eyes on movable and flickering stalks. Two large claws protrude from its thorax in front of four other pairs of spindly walking legs. Its exoskeleton is dark brown in color.

links.title: Demon, Lesser Ooze (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature appears as a humanoid-shaped swirling form of blackish ooze. Its head is crocodilian and its mouth is lined with sharpened teeth.

links.title: Demon, Barizou (Assassin Demon; 3pp)
links.snippet: This humanoid appears to be halfling-sized or smaller with gray skin, a wolf-like head, membranous wings, and hands and feet that end in sharpened talons. Its mouth is littered with a row of razor-sharp fangs. Its back is mottled with…

links.title: Disenchanter (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature resembles a massive blue furred camel with slightly translucent skin and a long snout that ends in a suction-like cup.

links.title: Drake, Fire
links.snippet: This creature appears to be a small, red dragon with translucent scales, mottled mauve and burgundy. Heat and steam rise from its body. Its wings are mottled black and its eyes are crimson.

links.title: Gronk
links.snippet: The most notable feature of the hairy humanoid is large curved horn projecting from the forehead. The creature’s thick limbs and torso betray its muscular power.

links.title: Gutslug
links.snippet: This slimy, sticky, worm bears a striking resemblance to humanoid entrails. Its lengthy body looks like a lumpy, veined, gray tube approximately 10 feet long, but no thicker than a sword handle. It has no eyes, and its large, round mouth…

links.title: Horsefly, Giant
links.snippet: This creature looks like an 8-foot long hairy, black fly.

links.title: Mephit, Lightning
links.snippet: This small creature appears to be a humanoid-shaped being composed of electricity. Bluish-white lighting arcs in small bursts from its body.

links.title: Mephit, Smoke
links.snippet: This small winged humanoid has soot-colored skin, crimson eyes, and dark wings. Small trails of smoke stream from its body as it flies along.

links.title: Bat, Mobat (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature appears as a large brown bat with razor-sharp fangs, and eyes that glow green.

links.title: Phooka
links.snippet: These small hairy creatures resemble a cross between a goblin and a child’s fuzzy play bear. They have wide set glowing golden eyes and long pointed ears like those of a donkey. They have a mouth to match their ears, complete with buck…

links.title: Shadow, Wolf
links.snippet: This creature appears as a large black hound formed of darkness. Its eyes burn with a crimson fire.

links.title: Shark, Hammerhead
links.snippet: Beneath this sleek gray shark’s unusually shaped head, a disproportionately small mouth flashes with razor-sharp teeth.

links.title: Shark, Tiger
links.snippet: Larger than the average shark, the ravenous tiger shark is a giant shark.

links.title: Slithering Tracker (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature looks like a long, thin transparent protoplasm, almost snake-like in form.

links.title: Spriggan (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature resembles an ugly, stocky gnome with a bulbous nose and reddish eyes. It has a shaggy dark mustache and ratty beard, both unkempt and caked with dirt and filth.

links.title: Tsathar Scourge
links.snippet: This vile creature resembles an upright, humanoid frog with gray flesh and reddish-gold eyes. Its humanoid arms end in wicked claws.

links.title: Archon, Hound
links.snippet: This canine-headed humanoid’s well-groomed appearance and polished greatsword show it to be more than a common beast.

links.title: Medusa Head, Shrieking
links.snippet: XP 1,200 Advanced screaming medusa head NE Small undead Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +2

links.title: Beetle, Giant Stag
links.snippet: XP 1,200 N Large vermin Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0

links.title: Div, Aghash
links.snippet: Draped in rags and hunched over on goatlike legs, this creature possesses a featureless face, save for a large eye ringed by fangs.

links.title: Magma Dragon, Wyrmling
links.snippet: Between this dragon’s jet-black scales run glowing rivulets of lava, and veins aglow with heat shine in the membranes of its wings.

links.title: Festrog, Mountain
links.snippet: From the shadows steps forth a hideously malformed corpse with a crooked spine and bent limbs wrapped with thick folds of sinewy muscle. Its hairless, graygreen flesh erupts with large, swollen pustules. As soon as it senses you, it drops…

links.title: Golem, Carrion
links.snippet: A lurching mash-up of rotting flesh, jagged bone, and coarse hair, this humanoid monstrosity reeks of death and decay.

links.title: Ahlinni
links.snippet: This creature has a long, straight beak—fully half the length of its body—that tapers to a fine point. Wicked claws sprout from its wings. Its eyes are whitish-pink and its feathers are a mixture of blues, reds, yellows, and greens.

links.title: Amphisbaena (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature appears as a huge snake with a head at each end of its body. Its scales are blackish-blue with bands of lighter blue fading into its coloration near the middle of its body. Its heads are glossy-black and its eyes are crimson.

links.title: Bone Cobbler
links.snippet: This creature appears as a tattered and desiccated humanoid with grayish flesh drawn tight over its bones. Its eyes are hollow sockets of darkness and its clothes are rags.

links.title: Clockwork Swarm
links.snippet: A mass of tiny insect-like mechanical creatures surges closer.

links.title: Demon, Azizou (Pain Demon; 3pp)
links.snippet: This small humanoid creature has a jackal-like head, a mouthful of fangs, and large, round eyes with slit-pupils of gray. Its grayish skin is covered in patches of coarse black hair. Membranous wings protrude from its back and its hands…

links.title: Dragonfly, Giant (3pp)
links.snippet: This insect resembles a normal dragonfly but is about 5 feet long. Its skin glitters beautifully in the sunlight, belying the danger that the creature represents.

links.title: Eel, Electric (Dire)
links.snippet: Dire electric eels have elongated, cylindrical bodies. Their coloration is dark gray-brown on the back and yellow or orange on the belly. Mature males have a darker color on the belly. They have no scales. The mouth is square, and…

links.title: Gargoyle, Green Guardian (3pp)
links.snippet: This winged humanoid creature is carved of a strange green stone with eyes rich black in color.

links.title: Golem, Carrion (stand-in)
links.snippet: Some tieflings and other deformed spellcasters enjoy creating carrion golems in their own image. These disgusting variants are still cobbled together from an assortment of corpses, but the crafter carefully sculpts them and covers strange…

links.title: Golem, Carrion (Weaponized)
links.snippet: Eschewed by all but the most ruthless warlords, these carrion golems are excellent instruments of terror. Rigged with alchemical explosives inside their chest cavities, these monstrosities can be sent into a rebellious town or hamlet to…

links.title: Golem, Stone Guardian (3pp)
links.snippet: This automaton looks to be carved from mud and stone. It stands as tall as a human and where its heart would be, if it were alive, is a fist-sized rounded reddish-colored stone.

links.title: Grave Risen
links.snippet: This rotting, worm-ridden corpse is draped in tattered and loosely fitting rags and dented and armor. Blackened eye sockets serve as its eyes, and the stench of death clings to its body. Its nails are long and filthy, caked with dirt and…

links.title: Grick, Jungle
links.snippet: These surface-adapted varieties of the underground grick are shades of green and lurk in the undergrowth of jungles or climb low-hanging branches to drop on unsuspecting prey.

links.title: Kamadan (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature resembles a large leopard-like cat with emerald green eyes. From its shoulders sprout six long serpents, blackish-green in color, each about twice the length of a normal human. The serpents’ eyes are reddish-yellow.

links.title: Ooze, Crystal
links.snippet: A seemingly mundane puddle, patch of moist stone, or glistening rock is suddenly revealed to be more as a terrible pseudopod lashes out.

links.title: Otyugh, Corpsefeaster
links.snippet: This three-legged freak is mostly mouth. Three tentacles, two tipped with barbs and one with eyes, extend from its sides.

links.title: Rot Grub (CR 4)
links.snippet: Rot grubs are nauseating parasites that feed on flesh and nest in corpses. Generally, a handful of the grubs infest a single corpse at a time, and a DC 15 Perception check is enough to notice and avoid the grubs. Otherwise, 1d6 grubs…

links.title: Shark, Great White
links.snippet: This immense silvery beast oozes strength, power, and speed. Its gigantic maw is lined with rows of ragged-looking teeth, and its pitch-black, emotionless eyes give nothing away.

links.title: Wight, Cairn
links.snippet: XP 1200 LE Medium undead Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

links.title: Wight, Frost
links.snippet: The pale flesh of this walking corpse is rotting and putrid, its body skeletal in places, ice and frost cling to its hair, and its eye sockets glow with blue-white light.

links.title: Wolf-Spider
links.snippet: This creature appears as a large monstrous spider with the head of a wolf. Its eyes are multifaceted like a spider’s, and its fangs are complimented by a set of spider-like mandibles.

links.title: Animated Object (Large)

links.title: Chupacabra, Giant Winged

links.title: Crab, Giant Hermit

links.title: Crawling Hand, Giant

links.title: Demon, Brimorak

links.title: Blue Dragon, Wyrmling
links.snippet: With scales the color of the desert sky, this large, serpentine dragon moves with an unsettling grace.

links.title: Drake, Flame
links.snippet: This ferocious creature looks like a red-and-yellow scaled dragon, but with only two legs.

links.title: Ghoul Bat (Skaveling)

links.title: Sphinx, Hieracosphinx

links.snippet: This spectral figure is composed of darkness and has no discernible features except its eyes—two small pinpoints of light that burn with a hellish glow.

links.title: Elemental Fiend, Airfiend (3pp)

links.title: Gargoyle, Margoyle
links.snippet: This creature looks like a hideously ugly humanoid chiseled of brown stone. Two large horns protrude from its head, just above its eyes. Four large stony spikes jut from its shoulder blades. Its hands and feet end in sharpened claws.

links.title: Golem, Ice (3pp)
links.snippet: This automaton is nearly twice as tall as a normal human and seems to be chiseled from ice and snow.

links.title: Sea Serpent, Gilded

links.snippet: This creature looks like a gorilla with the head of a tiger. Its arms end in sharpened claws and its fur is orange–brown. Its head is striped like that of a normal tiger.

links.title: Troll, Scrag

links.title: Wight, Brute
links.snippet: The flesh of this walking corpse is rotting and putrid, its body skeletal in places and its eye sockets glowing with red light.

links.title: Ant Lion, Giant Adult (Lacewing)
links.snippet: This spindly insect, borne aloft on four delicate wings, snaps its mandibles in obvious hunger.

links.snippet: This squat, reptilian monster has transparent skin, eight legs, bony spurs jutting from its back, and eyes that glow with pale green fire.

links.title: Demon, Babau
links.snippet: This emaciated figure looks like a horned human skeleton smothered within a bone-tight hide of slimy leather.

links.title: Green Dragon, Very Young

links.snippet: Between this dragon’s jet-black scales run glowing rivulets of lava, and veins aglow with heat shine in the membranes of its wings.

links.title: Basilisk, Crimson
links.snippet: This creature looks like a stocky, 8-legged, crimson scaled reptile. A row of bony spines juts from its back and runs the length of its body. Its eyes have a ghostly blue glow.

links.title: Bhuta (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature appears to be a decayed humanoid whose body still shows signs of trauma. Its flesh, where it still exists, is pulled tight over its skeletal frame. Its eyes are now hollow sockets of darkness.

links.snippet: This entity resembles a large bipedal bear-like creature with upward curving horns, elongated fangs, and blackish-gray fur. Its hands end in eagle-like talons.

links.title: Demon, Cambion (3pp)
links.snippet: This demonic-looking creature resembles a somewhat stocky humanoid with scaly blue skin, small fangs, and tiny dark horns that protrude above its crimson-colored eyes.

links.title: Flytrap, Dire
links.snippet: This huge cluster of vines eats large creatures for breakfast.

links.title: Ghoul, Wolf (Dire) (3pp)
links.snippet: XP 2,400 NE Large undead Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent ; Perception +16

links.title: Golem, Mummy(3pp)
links.snippet: This creature appears as a humanoid wrapped in age-worn, filthy bandages. Two glowing red eyes peer from beneath its wrapped form.

links.title: Half-Fiend Griffon
links.snippet: This red-eyed griffon has black fur and a set of wicked ebon wings springing from its back. Its front half resembles that of a great raven, while its hindquarters resemble those of a lean panther.

links.title: Kamadan, Poisonous
links.snippet: This creature resembles a large leopard-like cat with emerald green eyes. From its shoulders sprout six long serpents, blackish-green in color, each about twice the length of a normal human. The serpents’ eyes are reddish-yellow.

links.snippet: A 6-foot tall muscular humanoid with black, rubbery flesh stretches two large, leathery wings in place of its arms. Rigid plates of razor-sharp bone jut from the wing’s outer edge. It perches on long, muscular legs that end in three-toed…

links.snippet: This creature is a winged bull with the face of a bearded man. It looks on you with a calm and knowing gaze.

links.title: Roper, Stone
links.snippet: This creature is a vaguely cone-shaped creature with six tentacles and a large, gaping mouth filled with serrated teeth.

links.title: Terra-cotta Archer
links.snippet: XP 2,400 N Medium construct Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision ; Perception +8

links.title: Turtle-Shark
links.snippet: From a distance this creature resembles a giant snapping turtle. It has a peaked and craggy shell from which protrude four long fins and a scowling head at the end of a long neck. Rather than a turtle’s head, however, this creature’s head…

links.snippet: XP 3,200 N Huge construct Init -2 Senses darkvision 60, low-light vision ; Perception -5

links.title: Demon, Shadow
links.snippet: Only this shadowy bat-winged demon’s teeth and claws have any sense of physicality to them—the rest is lost in darkness.

links.title: Devil, Salikotal (Vengeance Devil)
links.snippet: On lean limbs the color of spilt blood creeps a being of sinister grace. Eyes like embers and a sneer full of needle-thin teeth gleam from an unmistakably fiendish visage. A pair of crimson wings sprout from the back of the hairless…

links.title: Div, Pairaka
links.snippet: Blue-skinned and draped in revealing attire, this humanoid fiend has a sultry gaze suggesting all manner of debased pleasures.

links.title: Half-Dragon (Black) / Half Basilisk
links.snippet: This six-legged dragon flaps its massive wings as it lowers its head to glare with hideous glowing eyes.

links.title: Black Dragon, Young
links.snippet: Hissing green acid drips from the fanged maw of this black-scaled, horned dragon.

links.title: Blue Dragon, Very Young

links.title: White Dragon, Juvenile

links.title: Brine Dragon, Young
links.snippet: A blue-green neck frill sweeps back from the head of this dragon, leading to a body of shiny scales and fin-like crests.

links.title: Lightning Elemental, Huge
links.snippet: This creature looks like a dark storm cloud, with sparks suggesting eyes and long sweeping arms charged with bolts of lightning.

links.title: Jellyfish, Giant
links.snippet: The bell of this enormous amber jellyfish is as large as a carriage. A sinister bloom of tentacles dangles and writhes below.

links.title: Naga, Water
links.snippet: Slender spines and brightly colored frills stretch back from the human-like face of this massive water snake. Every motion of the serpent’s long form sets its brightly patterned scales and glistening fins to flashing like gems in the surf.

links.title: Protean, Naunet
links.snippet: Tentacles tipped with snapping jaws emerge from this serpentine creature’s back, complementing the vicious maw in its reptilian face.

links.title: Qlippoth, Shoggti
links.snippet: This pale creature has four suckered arms that end in pincers. A gnashing maw gapes in its head between two staring eyes.

links.title: Abyssal Wolf
links.snippet: This creature is a man-sized wolf with deep blackish-blue fur and fiery orange eyes. Its coat is caked with blood, and bits of flesh hang from its toothy maw.

links.title: Addanc
links.snippet: This monster possesses the form of a crocodile plus the fur of a beaver and the behavior of both.

links.title: Amir (Noble Jann)

links.title: Apparition

links.title: Arcanoplasm (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature resembles a giant, pale amoeba shot through with stripes of dark gray. Caught within its protoplasmic form are half-digested creatures of various types and sizes.

links.title: Brass Man (3pp)
links.snippet: This creature resembles a humanoid constructed of brass. Its features are exquisite and delicate, and ancient runes and symbols adorn its body.

links.title: Burning Dervish
links.snippet: This creature looks like a normal human with symbols and tattoos of alien design covering almost all of its body.

links.title: Demon, Nabasu (Demonling; 3pp)

links.snippet: This reddish-gray scaled humanoid stands taller than a human. Its hands are clawed and its feet cloven. Oversized fangs jut from its upper jaw and drip foul-smelling saliva. Small horns protrude from just above its eyes, curving backwards.…

links.title: Dragon, Corruptor
links.snippet: The corruptor dragon’s eyes and permanent scowl exude a calculated malice, and her putrid green scales radiate the smell of earthy decay.

links.title: Dragon, Esoteric
links.snippet: Dragon, Esoteric

links.title: Dragon, Frostdeath
links.snippet: The winds become freezing as a horrifying skeleton of a dragon swoops towards you through the sky, rimes of frost sent aflutter in the air as its decaying but powerful wings carry it aloft.

links.title: Dragon, Harmonic
links.snippet: This multi-colored dragon’s wings display mesmerizing complexity, and her voice is as beautiful as it is powerful.

links.title: Dragon, Ice
links.snippet: This dragon seems to be made of massive ice crystals, his long talons still bloodied from a recent kill.

links.title: Dragon, Iron
links.snippet: This hulking metal dragon is covered in huge iron scales which crackle with electricity.

links.title: Dragon, Ladon
links.snippet: A hundred heads on a hundred necks rise from the immense body of this hydra-like dragon. Its scales have the color of wood, but the shine and hardness of bronze.

links.snippet: Giant Mythic Adult Bronze Dragon CR 17/MR 6

links.title: Dragon, Outer
links.snippet: Outer dragons, natives of the vast reaches of space, can be encountered on diverse worlds. They are generally neutral, but their alignments vary more than those of other dragons.

links.title: Dragon, Planar
links.snippet: Planar dragons originate in the Outer Planes but migrate via portals or other methods to the Material Plane . There, they reshape their lairs to ref lect their home planes.

links.title: Dragon, Radiant
links.snippet: This dragon glows with a soft yellow light, and displays a gentle smile despite brutal fangs and claws.

links.title: Dragon, Ruby
links.snippet: This chubby dragonet’s scales glitter like red gems; its coppery claws look as sharp as knives and apt to burrow through the hardest rock.

links.title: Dragon, Shadow
links.snippet: Smooth and obsidian-skinned, the dragon’s every step drips with terror, his nostrils emanating otherworldly smoke which dances with a life of its own.

links.title: Drake, Coral
links.snippet: Swimming upright, this creature seemingly peels itself from the vibrant seascape before striking with needle-thin claws, shredding teeth, and a wickedly curved stinger.

links.title: Drake, Sea (Mythic)
links.snippet: Not quite sea serpent or dragon, this vicious beast is covered with shiny blue-green scales. Its arms serve as both wings and flippers.

links.title: Dream Imp Companion, Wild (3pp)
links.snippet: This squat little furry creature has bat wings attached to its arms. It chortles while digging through scraps in search of useful tools.

links.title: Dream Imp Hero (3pp)
links.snippet: This bipedal bear wears a vest, belt, and goggles over its purple-tinged fur. The wings on its back have been enhanced through artifice.

links.title: Dream Imp Hero, Wild (3pp)

links.title: Earthen Host
links.snippet: This old dragon’s body is covered in acid-scorched rocks and is inhabited by a band of earth elementals.

links.title: Kongamato, Mythic
links.snippet: A massive draconic creature with a birdlike head dives from the sky, letting loose a piercing scream as it descends.

links.title: Lindwurm
links.snippet: This savage beast looks like a cross between a primal snake and a primitive dragon, its long, coiling body muscular, covered in rough, green scales and supported by two arms.

links.title: Linnorm, Fjord (Mythic)
links.snippet: This massive, eel-like dragon has two webbed talons. Its tail ends in large and powerful-looking flukes.

links.title: Linnorm, Midgard Serpent
links.snippet: This titanic sea serpent is impossibly long, with endless coils covered in fins and spines. Its enormous head seems almost to blot out the sun as it rises above to strike.

links.title: Marraco
links.snippet: This spiny, wingless reptile has an enormous mouth split into gruesome quadrate jaws, with a toothy maw large enough for a human to stand in and tongues of flame licking out past its massive fangs.

links.title: Pythonae
links.snippet: This huge serpent’s scales glitter green where they are not covered in mud. It almost appears to give you a clever, knowing smile while it crawls out of a vast crevice in the earth.

links.title: Sea Serpents

links.title: Tarantasio
links.snippet: A huge, horned head emerges from the lake’s troubled waters on top of a long, snakelike body. Flames and noxious fumes erupt from its mouth and flared nostrils.

links.snippet: This limbless, indigo wyrm has two fire-breathing heads and two poison-dripping tails.

links.title: Wyvern, Spinetail
links.snippet: The creature before you is unmistakably draconic, with two large leathery wings and a reptilian body and head, though it has no legs, and its tail ends in a sharp, curved stinger. While its body is mostly covered in pale white-green…

links.title: Wyvern, Twintail
links.snippet: Before you, you see a winged serpent, its body long and snaking, with a pair of oversized, bat-like wings, and the head of a viper. Its body splits near the end, leaving it with two tails, each of which has a single oversized stinger on…

links.title: Wyvernhemoth
links.snippet: Flexing its wings and stinger-tipped tail with brutal intent, this immense creature acts more beast than dragon despite the obvious similarities.

links.snippet: This graceful woman is glad in a loose, flowing of shadowy gossamer. Its skin is all in shades of gray, with eyes of luminous shadow and long, flowing jet black hair.

links.title: Anguana
links.snippet: The upper body of this creature appears as a beautiful elfin woman with pale lavender hair and skin. Her cloven-hooved legs are furred like a goat in the same color.

links.title: Anjana
links.snippet: This dainty sprite is dressed in a flowing belted tunic, with skin and cloth each so pale as to seem almost translucent, faintly glowing and with long blonde hair adorned with a crown of flowers. She has two transparent wings and carries a…

links.snippet: XP 19,200 CN Medium fey Init +10; Senses low-light vision; Perception +22

links.title: Autumn Hora Queen
links.snippet: This beautiful woman dances among the falling leaves without leaving a trace; her hair, skin, and eyes match the green, gold, brown, and red of the autumn trees, as do the veils she wears.

links.title: Aventesma
links.snippet: This towering humanoid is eerily thin, with huge yellow eyes staring out from its gaunt face and pale ragged garments shrouding its willowy, green-skinned form.

links.title: Avernalis
links.snippet: Surrounded by eerie lights, this tall, beautiful silver-haired woman seems to own the deep caverns around, a somber expression on her exquisite features.

links.title: Baba Yaga’s Riders
links.snippet: Many fey creatures aided Baba Yaga’s invasion of the eastern kingdoms, doing so for the sheer love of carnage and chaos. Others, however, possessed more inscrutable motives. Every century, in the year that precedes the return of Baba Yaga,…

links.title: Buckawn Gang Leader
links.snippet: This diminutive warrior has nut-brown skin and suspicious eyes. He grips a slim blade and adopts a cautious pose in rustic garb, clearly ready to face any danger.

links.title: Camena Oracle
links.snippet: A beautiful female figure emerges from the pond, her body apparently composed entirely of water, a melodious song on her lips as she advances towards you.

links.title: Cogrunt
links.snippet: This gray, squat creature resembles a bat-eared cross between an ape and a goblin. It wears a heavy, soot-stained apron and a bandolier full of tools and pouches.

links.title: Crossroads Guardian
links.snippet: This clear-eyed humanoid stands with flowing hair and a noble bearing. It holds its weapon at the ready, not threatening but standing prepared to protect.

links.title: Cu Sith
links.snippet: This imposing beast is as large as a bull and covered in intertwining roots, plant matter, and shaggy green and white fur that terminates in a long, plaited tail. Its eyes glow with a fiery green light.

links.title: Debased Asrai

links.title: Draxie
links.snippet: This smiling reptilian sprite has vibrant scales and membranous wings, with large, round, and brightly colored eyes contrasting with vivid frills. Its riotous coloration is matched only by its ebullient cheerfulness and winsome grin.

links.title: Dryad, Ashbound
links.snippet: The creature before you resembles a beautiful young woman with alabaster white skin, with flowers in her hair and dressed only in a simple outfit made of leaves and vines. On closer inspection, you realize that her skin, while smooth, is…

links.title: Dryad, Oakbound
links.snippet: The creature before you resembles a woman with dark, swarthy skin. She is clothed only in moss, and as you look more closely, you see that her skin is hard and marbled with a pattern that resembles wood grain.

links.title: Dryad, Yewbound
links.snippet: The creature before you appears at first to be a stopped old crone with dark skin and lank, mossy hair. Upon closer inspection, however, you realize that her skin is in fact bark-like and horribly scarred, and that her hair is not…

links.title: Fairymaid

links.title: Fata
links.snippet: A beautiful, matronal woman in a long dress greets you with an enigmatic smile. Her eyes glitter with the same light as the golden wand in her hands.

links.title: Fey Grizzly Bear

links.title: Fey Wolf

links.title: Gremlin (3pp-NWP)

links.title: Gremlin, Erinat
links.snippet: The pockets of this urchin are stuffed with worthless objects.

links.title: Gremlin, Hobkins
links.snippet: This small, blue-gray humanoid has glowing eyes and huge ears on its round, oversized head.

links.title: Gumiho
links.snippet: This nine-tailed silver fox has bright, intelligent eyes of emerald green and wears a strange glowing amulet around its neck.

links.title: Hamadryad Queen
links.snippet: This imposing woman strides towards you with a majestic gait, her dress and hair stud with starry lights and nuanced with all the colours of a forest’s foliage in every season of the year.

links.title: Harpy, Miniature

links.title: Hora, Winter

links.title: Liath Sidhe
links.snippet: You have just the time to notice a strange movement in the tall grass before a little creature springs towards you at full speed, waving a sword almost as tall as itself and crying something like “Hey you! Do you want a face full of head?”

links.title: Liath Sidhe Swarm
links.snippet: The hillside seems to come alive; hundreds of minuscule warriors charge in your direction, swirling their shining swords over their heads and chanting a strange battle cry: “We won’t obey anyone evermore!”. This could be your worst…

links.title: Maskinganna
links.snippet: This muscular beast-man has ruddy fur and back-bending legs ending in hooves. Its hands are humanoid and its face resembles a goat or kudu, with long, spiraling black horns.

links.title: Mazzamurello
links.snippet: A tiny man with a red suit and pointy hat and shoes jumps and springs around the forest. In a few moments he’s gone, leaving only the silvery sounds of laughter behind.

links.title: Meiga, Cartuxeira
links.snippet: This elderly woman is dressed in colorful, flowing skirts and scarves. Her keen eyes gleam with hawkish intensity.

links.title: Meiga, Lobismuller
links.snippet: This mature female humanoid is garbed in once-fine raiment now worn and patched, along with skillfully stitched animal pelts. Her eyes glow a wolfish yellow in a cold, calculating gaze.

links.title: Meiga, Vedoira
links.snippet: This slender, dark-haired female humanoid has an aged wisdom in her eyes that belies her ageless face. Jeweled ornaments spangle her vestments.

links.title: Moura Encantada
links.snippet: This lovely lass has a winsome beauty with delicate features and voluptuous curves. Her skin is pale green and her hair shimmers like spun silver and gold, with leaves caught in her tresses.

links.title: Mythic Dryad
links.snippet: This strange, beautiful woman has flesh that seems made of wood and vibrant hair that resembles leaves and blossoms.

links.title: Mythic Fastachee
links.snippet: This gaunt, two-foot-tall humanoid figure appears made of corn husks, and carries an oversized basket filled with corn.

links.title: Mythic Forlarren
links.snippet: This humanoid creature has the legs of a bald goat , a completely hairless body, and a horned head with a sinister expression.

links.title: Mythic Fossegrim
links.snippet: This striking, blue-eyed man with luminous skin and flowing white hair holds an ethereal harp.

links.title: Mythic Gremlin, Fuath
links.snippet: This waterlogged gremlin has lobster claws for hands and an almost canine face with webbed ears.

links.title: Mythic Gremlin, Jinkin
links.snippet: Grimacing like a maniac, this lean little bat-eared horror displays a mouth full of needle-like teeth and glowing, orange eyes.

links.title: Mythic Gremlin, Nuglub
links.snippet: This hideous, hunchbacked creature has three glowing blue eyes. Oily hair grows from its head and back, covering it like a cloak.

links.title: Mythic Grig
links.snippet: Perched on the prickly legs of a cricket, this tiny creature has gossamer wings and the upper body of an elven woman.

links.title: Mythic Oceanid
links.snippet: This beautiful woman is clad only in sea foam and her long, white hair, which cascades over her body.

links.snippet: A tall and majestic woman looks at you, sunlight and starlight dancing in her eyes and hair, her skin as pale as starry twilight.

links.title: Summer Hora Queen
links.snippet: This beautiful woman appears bathed in constant sunlight, with skin and clothing of red, orange, and yellow, like the sunlight of high summer.

links.title: Tardo
links.snippet: This pale-skinned humanoid is shrouded in a great hooded cloak of flowing green. Its skin is mottled with a patchwork of brownish spots and one hand is human-like but the other is twisted into an inhuman claw.

links.title: Tardo Lobisomem
links.snippet: XP 1,200 NE Small fey ( shapechanger ) Init +5; Senses low-light vision ; Perception +10; Aura frightful presence (10 ft., DC 16, 1d6 rounds)

links.title: Thalia, Muse of Comedy
links.snippet: This beautiful woman appears imposing and regal, yet there’s a light of mockery and mischievousness in her eyes

links.title: Thyad (Baccae Queen)
links.snippet: A wild gaze glows in this beautiful woman’s eyes while she dances on the grass, wine smeared on the animal hides she wears and blood on her hands.

links.title: Umutwa
links.snippet: You see a tiny fey creature, well-armed and with a bold expression.

links.title: Velha da Égua Branca
links.snippet: This wrinkled, aged woman wears a white headdress adorned with red ribbons and clutches a dagger. Her clothing and leather shoes are otherwise ragged. She sits astride a blazing white stallion bedecked with tack and harness covered in…

links.title: Whisperer, Lesser
links.snippet: This tall, looming, faceless creature is impossibly thin and impeccably dressed.

links.title: Wild Hunt Enchantress
links.snippet: This staggeringly beautiful woman wearing only a diaphanous dress seems to move with such grace that she seems to be floating. Translucent, arcane tattoos twist, wind and turn upon her delicate skin, almost as pale as her cascading, snowy…

links.title: Wild Hunt Vanguard
links.snippet: Before you stands a knight larger than life itself. 8 feet tall, with shoulders like a bull and enormous elk antlers spreading from the gleaming helmet of his thick armor. His gauntlets hold a monstrously large, foreboding mace with…

links.title: Winter Hora Queen
links.snippet: This beautiful woman appears enveloped in a cold, crystalline aura; her skin and hair are pale, her eyes and clothes as blue as deep ice.

links.title: Xana
links.snippet: This female humanoid has pale skin but raven-dark hair. Her eyes are luminous pools of blue and flowing robes drape her slender form.

links.title: Zankallala
links.snippet: You see a funny little person with enormous whiskers and wearing what looks like a beehive or wasp nest for a hat.

links.title: Al-Ruhban
links.snippet: This tall humanoid has light silvery-gold hair and pale skin covered with odd tattoo-like symbols and patterns in sky-blue pigment that match the color of its eyes. Its arms are unusually long, with its hands dangling to its knees.

links.title: Angurboda
links.snippet: The lovely lass standing before you roars as she ripples and deforms into the massive musculature of a towering harridan, breasts and belly distended, with lank, straggly hair framing a monstrous face with huge fangs jutting from her mouth.

links.title: Antaeus
links.snippet: This broad-shouldered humanoid has rippling musculature, his dark skin gleaming as if oiled. He has a full beard, shaggy hair, and a haughty mien.

links.title: Apocalypse Man
links.snippet: Arcane energies swirl into the monstrously distorted giant. His visage is taut with animalistic hunger.

links.title: Great Old One, Tawil at’Umr

links.title: Great Old One, Yig

links.title: Roper, Shadow

links.title: Gluttonspawn

links.title: Greedspawn

links.title: Pridespawn
links.snippet: This gaunt, near-skeletal humanoid lurches on back-bent, dog-like legs, its hideous mouth flanked by tiny arms with three-fingered hands. It has a long mane of twisted hair.

links.title: Slothspawn
links.snippet: This hairless humanoid lurches on back-bent, dog-like legs, its hideous mouth flanked by tiny arms with three-fingered hands. This rolls of excess skin drape over its hunched frame.

links.snippet: Cat, Great

links.title: Fish, Dunkleosteus
links.snippet: This gigantic, prehistoric fish has a head like a snapping turtle, complete with sharp, toothlike plates.

links.title: Fish, Piranha Swarm
links.snippet: This school of red-bellied fish swims swiftly, each tiny mouth filled with rows of razor-sharp teeth ready to feast on flesh.

links.title: Barracuda, Medium
links.snippet: The barracuda is a predatory fish that averages about 2 feet long and weighs 10-15 pounds. Its body is bluish-gray near the front changing to silver mottled with black spots in the rear. Its mouth is filled with razor-sharp teeth. Medium…

links.title: Megafauna, Elasmotherium
links.snippet: This lumbering, four-legged, rhino-like beast has thick hide and a single immense horn protruding from the top of its head.

links.title: Megafauna, Titanoboa
links.snippet: This immense serpent moves in deliberate, slithering undulations, its forked tongue tasting the air eagerly for the scent of prey.

links.title: Megafauna, Brontotherium
links.snippet: This stocky quadruped’s lowered head puts its intimidating Y-shaped horn on full display.

links.title: Primate, Ape, Megaprimatus
links.snippet: This titanic ape has great patches of coarse gray and brown fur, and its skin is thick and leathery.

links.title: Automaton, Master
links.snippet: This construct is covered with elaborate markings. Its arms end in tremendous hooks, and the core in its head glows with light.

links.title: Colossus, Sphinx
links.snippet: This stone edifice resembles a lion with a regal human face, garbed in royal clothing.

links.title: Golem, Adamantine, Hell Engine
links.snippet: Wicked spikes and infernal runes decorate this black metal construct’s armor. Unholy flames billow from industrial stacks atop its crown and back.

links.title: Golem, Sand
links.snippet: This towering creature appears to be made entirely of sand, with pockets of soft earth and rock reinforcing its tall, humanoid form.

links.title: Golem, Magebane (3pp)
links.snippet: This iron mechanical man is difficult to see—surrounded as it is by a hemispheric aura of flashing, prismatic colors—but is clearly covered in gold and silver runes and carrying a spear, with a crossbow mounted on each shoulder.

links.title: Golem, Mosaic Tile
links.snippet: The ground beneath you trembles slightly before erupting into a creature made from the very tiles you walk upon, its limbs suddenly bearing down upon you!

links.title: Golem, Mushroom
links.snippet: This enormous creature stalks forward on huge fibrous legs, a purplish glow emanating from its eyes and face that illuminates the underside of the large mushroom forming out of the top of its head.

links.title: Golem, Totem
links.snippet: The creaking of wood catches your attention and you realize that all of this statue’s many eyes are looking directly at you!

links.title: Golem, Treasure
links.snippet: XP 2,400 N Large construct Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision , treasure sense; Perception +2

links.title: Golem, Gold
links.snippet: This golden statue stands proud, bearing a regal scepter in one hand. Its other arm is stretched out, ending in an upraised fist.

links.title: Golem, Obsidian
links.snippet: This statue resembles a lean human cut from blackened glass stone. Numerous razor-sharp protuberances jut from its body.

links.title: Golem, Quintessence
links.snippet: This partially humanoid creature appears to be carved of smoky glass. Ghostly, screaming faces swirl within its immense body.

links.title: Golem, Viridium
links.snippet: This green glass statue has four arms, one of which forms a jagged sword and another that ends in a formidable shield.

links.title: Stone Golem, Fiend-Infused
links.snippet: The fists of this stone statue radiate flames that flicker in red and black and reek of brimstone. Its chiseled face bears a feral, wicked grin.

links.title: Wood Golem, Advanced
links.snippet: This human-sized automaton resembles a crude humanoid figure made of cast-off pieces of wood.

links.title: Gearsman, Recycled
links.snippet: Plates of mismatched metal cover gaps in the burnished brass armor encasing this construct. Exposed wires hang from its creaking joints, and its glowing glass eye appears to be cracked.

links.title: Robot, Gladiator
links.snippet: One of this metallic humanoid’s four arms ends in the barrel of a large-bore rifle, while another ends in a spinning circular blade. Its final two arms grasp a massive chainsaw.

links.title: Robot, Repair
links.snippet: This quadruped robot has glowing eyes and dexterous hands capable of examining and fixing machinery.

links.title: Building and Modifying Constructs
links.snippet: The Craft Construct feat allows a spellcaster to create all manner of permanent constructs in a process much like magic item creation. Each construct has a purchase price and a crafting cost, along with a list of requirements and the…

links.snippet: XP 600 CE Small fey Init +2; Senses low-light vision , Perception +7

links.title: Gremlin Spiderspawn (3pp)
links.snippet: Half gremlin, half spider, this ugly monster stands as tall as a man. Its segmented eyes reflect whatever it looks at like thousands of tiny mirrors.

links.title: Deep One Scion

links.title: Entothrope, Werewasp
links.snippet: With a stinger-tipped abdomen, large wings, compound eyes, and a pair of mandibles, this woman is more wasp than elf.

links.title: Giant, Mountain

links.title: Giant, Plague
links.snippet: This oversized humanoid is dressed in tattered rags that don’t quite cover its diseased body.

links.title: Giant, Shadow
links.snippet: This giant’s skin is a dusky gray, and her long hair matches the silvery hue of her armor.

links.title: Giant, Tomb
links.snippet: This towering, lean figure is hairless and has smooth, milky white skin. A scythe gleams in the giant’s hands.

links.snippet: Wereraptors fuse the senses of a predatory bird and the unique skills and traits of a humanoid, and thus enjoy heightened awareness and nimbleness. Like their animal kin, wereraptors are calculating and insightful, making them particularly…

links.title: Lycanthrope, Silverblood
links.snippet: This snarling creature has a woman’s body, but the head and claws of a savage wolf.

links.title: Troop, Hobgoblin Beastmasters
links.snippet: Several snarling, feral beasts are tightly leashed by grim hobgoblin handlers. The hobgoblins are armed with scimitars and javelins, while the beasts wear spiked collars and makeshift barding.

links.title: Troop, Hobgoblin Phalanx
links.snippet: XP 9,600 LE Medium humanoid ( goblinoid , troop) Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18

links.title: Troop, Cultist
links.snippet: A band of violet-skinned elves raises their hands high as vile magic swirls in the air above them.

links.title: Troop, Goblin
links.snippet: The pint-sized humanoids who make up this chattering, shrieking mob hold jagged swords and bare jagged teeth.

links.title: Troop, Outlaw
links.snippet: Over two dozen men and women clad in chain shirts and leather armor brandish their knives and swords menacingly.

links.title: Troop, Axers
links.snippet: These savvy veteran fighters carry an array of ranged and melee weapons at all times, and keep alert to ensure they’re always ready for whatever the enemy throws their way.

links.title: Troop, Forest Guardians
links.snippet: Well-worn bows in hand and swords on their hips, these fighters wear layers of camouflaging hides. They lurk in the forest’s shadows while they wait for the best time to strike.

links.title: Troop, Imperial Archers
links.snippet: Shining blades hanging at their belts, these soldiers march with jet-black bows held at the ready, their keen eyes scanning the battlefield for enemies.

links.title: Troop, Imperial Infantry
links.snippet: Wielding bright blades with the sharpest of edges, these stern-faced soldiers are clad in white tabards bearing a red symbol worn over gleaming armor.

links.title: Troop, Imperial Phalanx
links.snippet: Marching forward with expressionless faces, some of these soldiers carry wicked polearms and others bear metal shields with the symbol of their nation stamped on them.

links.title: Troop, Inquisitor
links.snippet: A column of soldiers move together, their weapons at the ready in a coordinated front.

links.title: Troop, Skirmishers
links.snippet: Wielding slings and various light weapons, these nimble fighters weave and dart through the surrounding trees while they hunt down invaders.

links.title: Behir, Hellfire
links.snippet: This enormous creature dashes forward in a flash of speed, the heat emanating from every pore of its body briefly flaring before a gout of explosive fire erupts from its maw!

links.title: Bulette, Advanced
links.snippet: This armor-plated creature’s toothy maw gapes wide as a fin-like dorsal plate rises between its shoulders.

links.title: Hydra (9-headed)
links.snippet: Multiple angry snake-like heads rise from the sleek, serpentine body of this terrifying monster.

links.title: Kaiju, Varklops
links.snippet: This immense, fiery-orange serpent has three horned heads, a pair of draconic wings, and a long tail tipped with four bony spikes.

links.title: Kaiju, Vorgozen
links.snippet: This mountain of filthy green sludge heaps up on itself, extending six tentacles and unfolding its core to reveal a single red eye.

links.title: Kaiju, Yarthoon
links.snippet: This immense pale blue worm raises one end of its body like a serpent, its many-toothed maw opening amid a ring of glowing eyes.

links.title: Manticore, Advanced
links.snippet: This creature has a vaguely humanoid head, the body of a lion, and the wings of a dragon. Its tail ends in long, sharp spikes.

links.title: Plague Swarm, Bat

links.title: Plague Swarm, Locust

links.title: Therianthrope, Wolfwere, Dire
links.snippet: This creature looks like a large bipedal wolf with thick gray fur and fiery yellow eyes. Sharpened fangs glisten from within its mouth. The creature wields a longsword in its human-like, fur covered hands.

links.title: Blight, Cave
links.snippet: Muscular tentacles ending in stalagmite-like stingers extend from this pale brown slime.

links.title: Blight, Desert
links.snippet: A roiling mass of orange-brown sludge studded with gleaming red eyes brandishes its lashing tentacles.

links.title: Blight, Forest
links.snippet: This mass of dark green protoplasm hangs thick and wet from the branches, and its long tentacles are tipped with thorny claws.

links.title: Blight, Mountain
links.snippet: This black mass of glistening, tar-like slime bubbles and oozes, its two long tentacles each tipped with a stony club.

links.title: Blight, Sewer
links.snippet: What appears to be a grotesque mass of sewage betrays its true nature with dozens of red eyes and two long, slimy, claw-tipped tentacles.

links.title: Blight, Swamp
links.snippet: A cloud of mosquitoes churns around this quivering blob, its body studded with red eyes and its five tentacles tipped with stingers.

links.title: Blight, Tundra
links.snippet: XP 76,800 NE Medium ooze (blight, cold) Init +14; Senses blindsight 120 ft.; Perception +24

links.title: Mold, Slime (Medium)
links.snippet: A large but colorful grove of small mushrooms and other tiny plants sprout upon a wide swath of moss.

links.title: Agathion, Muldnal
links.snippet: This diminutive, small-eyed creature is covered in dense, charcoal-gray fur and wears a dirt-stained smock; its pink nose twitches ceaselessly.

links.title: Agathion, Cervapral
links.snippet: This sleek, long-legged, antelope-like figure has majestic pronged horns and ruffs of white fur on its chest and neck.

links.title: Agathion, Reptial
links.snippet: This iguana-headed scholar wears a robe of frills and scales covered in baubles and trinkets.

links.title: Angel, Iophanite
links.snippet: This disc of flying metal is about the size of a wagon wheel and burns with yellow-white flame.

links.title: Psychopomp, Algea
links.snippet: This shrill swarm of whip-poor-wills flies in a spiral, their airborne antics infused with streamers of pale blue mist.

links.title: Asura, Nikaramsa
links.snippet: This muscular giant has two ferocious lion heads, each with a long, black, lashing tongue.

links.title: Azata, Veranallia
links.snippet: This beautiful, rosy-haired woman has a lower body composed of a column of autumnal leaves and gently swaying vines.

links.title: Azata, Yamah
links.snippet: This blue-skinned woman has blue-and-white butterfly wings. Her black hair sparkles like a starlit sky.

links.title: Couatl, Mix
links.snippet: Dark scales marked with shining spots resembling stars cover this winged serpent. Faint red stripes span the length of its body.

links.title: Daemon, Alorbidaemon

links.snippet: This humanoid fiend has an overly long torso, black eyes, and a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth. It wears black robes that cover most of its rotting, frostbitten flesh.

links.title: Daemon, Venedaemon
links.snippet: Silken robes drape this androgynous fiend’s form, providing only an outline of the body beneath. Claw-tipped tentacles emerge from the cuffs, clutching wands and soul gems, while below its robe’s margins, its multiple-jointed legs—almost…

links.title: Daemon, Locusdaemon
links.snippet: This hideously deformed creature is wracked by agony, its flesh simultaneously frozen solid and burned black, disintegrating into the void and calcifying into tormented necrotic tissue pierced with scores of tiny holes as if by projectiles…

links.title: Daemon, Sepsidaemon
links.snippet: A long-beaked, crested head on a twisted neck rises from a formless, glowing mass of a body. Now and then, a grasping claw extends forth.

links.title: Demodand, Squamous
links.snippet: This titanic mass of flesh is covered in razor-sharp scales and has bony wings, four taloned arms, and a toothy, toad-like head.

links.title: Demon, Faerhle
links.snippet: XP 2,400 CE Medium outsider ( chaotic , demon , evil) Init +2; Senses darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +12

links.title: Demon, Kringkuk
links.snippet: XP 1,200 CE Small outsider ( chaotic , demon , evil) Init +7; Senses darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +11

links.title: Demon, Ghalzarokh
links.snippet: This corpulent, four-armed fiend is covered in yellow-orange dragon scales, and draconic wings sprout from its back.

links.title: Demon, Yaenit
links.snippet: Patches of fur adorn the sickly flesh of this gangly but muscular hyena-headed humanoid.

links.title: Demon Lord, Nocticula
links.snippet: This frighteningly majestic creature spreads wide her rune-adorned wings. Molten iron weeps from her hooves, and her three tails are studded with barbs.

links.title: Devil, Joyful Thing
links.snippet: This sluglike humanoid has neither arms nor legs and is covered in spiked, rusted chains. Its lolling tongue drips with thick saliva.

links.title: Devil, Suffragan
links.snippet: Bladed whips and spiked chains sprout from the stumps of this humanoid torso’s amputated limbs. Elongated saw blades loll out of its distended mouth.

links.title: Devil, Executioner
links.snippet: Corded muscles ripple under this massive devil’s red skin as her black wings beat overhead and her black eyes smolder like coals.

links.title: Devil, Brutalis
links.snippet: XP 9,600 LE Large outsider ( devil , evil , extraplanar , lawful ) Init +1 Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision , see in darkness ; Perception +15

links.title: Devil, Cabal (Uniila)
links.snippet: The curves of a shapely maiden define the outline of a mysterious figure wrapped in mist and strips of ancient robes. From beneath the rune-embroidered tatters stretch four, corpse-pale arms, each bearing either a blade or some mysterious…

links.title: Archdevil, Baalzebul
links.snippet: This swarm of droning black flies teems in the semblance of a winged angel with glowing red eyes.

links.title: Archdevil, Barbatos
links.snippet: This humanoid wears a shabby hooded cloak. Within the darkness of its hood, eerie eyes glow and strange shapes twitch.

links.title: Archdevil, Belial
links.snippet: One half of this figure’s body is gleaming and beautiful with an angelic wing, while the other is scaled, scarred, and blackened.

links.title: Archdevil, Dispater
links.snippet: This diabolic figure is draped in a kingly robe and crowned with iron horns. He bears a long, heavy mace of black metal.

links.title: Archdevil, Geryon
links.snippet: This tripartite being has three humanoid bodies engulfed from the waist down by a tangle of three immense serpents.

links.title: Archdevil, Mammon
links.snippet: This shining being is humanoid, but its four arms, multiple legs, and horned head reveal its diabolic nature.

links.title: Archdevil, Mephistopheles
links.snippet: This red-skinned devil has three sets of curving horns atop his brow and three mismatched pairs of wings.

links.title: Archdevil, Moloch
links.snippet: This immense figure appears to be a suit of blackened, diabolic armor filled with shrieking blasts of blistering fire.

links.title: Devil, Apostate (Deimavigga)
links.snippet: A grim metal mask floats above ceremonial armor that shifts and writhes, and long blades form fingers on gauntleted hands.

links.title: Div, Bushyasta
links.snippet: This gaunt figure has ashy yellow skin and a strange, feathered mask covering most of her face, save for her wide, fang-filled mouth.

links.title: Air Elemental, Tiny

links.title: Air Elemental, Elder
links.snippet: XP 12,800 N Huge outsider ( air , elemental , extraplanar ) Init +15; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +19

links.title: Air Elemental, Greater
links.snippet: This cloud-like creature has dark hollows reminiscent of eyes and a mouth, and a howling wind whips it into ominous shapes.

links.title: Fire Elemental, Tiny
links.snippet: XP 200 N Tiny outsider ( elemental , extraplanar , fire) Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

links.title: Positive Energy Elemental, Small
links.snippet: This creature appears as a shimmering and wavering sphere of brilliant white energy with small motes of light winking in and out of existence along its spherical form.

links.title: Psionic Elemental, Huge
links.snippet: This creature appears as a dark, semi-translucent cloud of swirling vapor. Looking closely at its form reveals two small pinpoints for eyes and a mouth composed of solid bits of matter swirling in the elemental’s form.

links.title: Elemental, Time(3pp)
links.snippet: This creature appears as a formless cloud of yellowish-red vapor or dust about 5 feet in diameter.

links.title: Water Elemental, Tiny
links.snippet: XP 200 N Tiny outsider ( elemental , extraplanar , water) Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

links.title: Water Elemental, Elder
links.snippet: This translucent creature’s shape shifts between a spinning column of water and a crashing wave.

links.title: Inevitable, Aevarut
links.snippet: LN Large outsider ( extraplanar , inevitable , lawful , mythic ) Init +15M; Senses darkvision 60 ft., true seeing ; Perception +26 Aura ravages of time (30 ft., DC 26)

links.title: Kyton, Feral
links.snippet: Although humanoid there is something animalistic and insectoid about this distended and misshapen thing, with too many arms of various sizes and twisted, deformed legs that seem somehow to have been lashed or wired into its demented body.…

links.title: Kyton, Oitos
links.snippet: The golden bones of this magnificent skeleton are clad in monstrous face-skins sewn into a cape and skirt adorned with gold pendants.

links.title: Manasaputra, Manu
links.snippet: A toned, regal human radiates a shifting aura of many colors and murmuring voices that seem strangely familiar.

links.title: Manasaputra, Solar Pitri
links.snippet: This massive, red-skinned creature surges with roiling waves of brilliant fire.

links.title: Ice Mephit Familiar

links.title: Akasha As Cybertech
links.snippet: Akasha is a type of magic that acts as a natural amplifier for other types of energy, but perhaps this type of magic does not mesh with the campaign you are envisioning.

links.title: Veilweaving Classes
links.snippet: Characters of any class can learn to use akasha through feats or other means, but the true masters are those who dedicate themselves to wielding this ancient power by advancing in a veilweaving class.

links.title: Channel Acid
links.snippet: Your energy blast deals acid damage. When it hits, you can spend a swift action to deal 2d6 acid damage at the start of the target’s turn for a number of rounds equal to your caster level (Fortitude negates). This damage doesn’t stack.

links.title: Channel Cold
