links.title: Channel Confusion
links.snippet: When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to confuse it for 1 round (Fortitude negates).

links.title: Channel Darkness
links.snippet: When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to blind it for 1 round (Fortitude negates).

links.title: Channel Evil
links.snippet: You can choose to heal undead with your energy blast. When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to give it 2 temporary negative levels (Fortitude negates).

links.title: Channel Fear
links.snippet: When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to cause it to become shaken for one round (Will negates).

links.title: Channel Fire
links.snippet: Your energy blast deals fire damage. When it hits, the target catches fire (Reflex negates).

links.title: Channel Nausea
links.snippet: When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to cause it to become nauseated for one round (Fortitude negates).

links.title: Channel Power
links.snippet: When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to bull rush it. Your CMB for this attempt is equal to this invocation’s spell level + your caster level + your spellcasting modifier.

links.title: Channel Sickness
links.snippet: When you hit a target with your energy blast, you can spend a swift action to cause it to become sickened for one round (Fortitude negates).

links.title: Essence Blast
links.snippet: You can use energy blast to target each creature in a 20-ft.-radius spread within medium range (100 ft. + 10 ft./level).

links.title: Essence Breath
links.snippet: You can use energy blast to target each creature in a 60-ft. cone, originating at your hand.

links.title: Essence Chain

links.title: Reignited
links.snippet: The Reignited rule-set is a “total conversion” meant to consolidate erratas, include new rules to streamline or enhance combat as well as the design of the system.

links.title: Classes
links.snippet: Classes gain skill ranks at 2nd level and every level thereafter instead of at 1st level. At 1st level instead, classes gain 1 skill rank in each skill they’d normally consider a “Class Skill”, multi-class characters count themselves as…

links.title: Races
links.snippet: Races receive little in the ways of changes in Reignited , most changes being related to racial abilities they have as well as potentially offering new racial abilities or alternate racial abilities.

links.title: Rules
links.snippet: This page covers miscellaneous rule alterations and inclusions. These rules are not separated by type (for example being separated into combat rules or advancement rules).

links.title: Skills

links.title: Weapon Techniques
links.snippet: Weapon Techniques are abilities which can be performed with weapons through the use of Stamina. Some techniques require no Stamina to use, however these techniques tend to be weaker and are meant to give expanded options instead.

links.title: Weapons
links.snippet: Weapons which go unlisted from this page (such as the Orc Double Axe, Switchscythe, and Klar) function as they normally do and can be taken as normal (with modified proficiency at the GM’s discretion).

links.title: Hedge Witch Traditions

links.title: Hedge Witch Spells
links.snippet: Hedge witch spells are divine in nature, but because of the way witchcraft works, many hedge witch spells are drawn from arcane spell lists. For spells that require a divine focus, a hedge witch uses her athame.

links.title: Black Magic Tradition
links.snippet: Black hedge witches, though the fewest in number, are unfortunately the most well known as their dastardly reputation and tales of their vile deeds have spread throughout the lands. Witches of the black magic tradition are mistresses of…

links.title: Healer Tradition
links.snippet: The desire and skill to heal comes naturally to hedge witches of the healer tradition. They are equipped with spells, potions and herbs to aid the ill and injured. Many work as midwives, or run herbalist shops.

links.title: Protector Tradition
links.snippet: Some hedge witches hear the call to protect and defend — be it a specific person or group of people, a specific place or sacred object, or simply to guard anyone or anything in need. Such driven individuals follow the protector tradition.

links.title: Seer Tradition
links.snippet: Most hedge witches on the path of the seer found themselves on the path as children, already able to see things before they happened, or know things about people that they should not have been able to know. Some trained their mind’s eye to…

links.title: Warchant
links.snippet: Warchant bards favor drums and other percussion instruments. A warchant bard with no ranks in any other bardic perform skill gains a +1 bonus to Fortitude saves at 2nd level, and a further +1 every six levels thereafter.

links.title: Aberrant Disciple
links.snippet: Those who were contaminated by incomprehensible forces, either through an eldritch ritual, a mixing of blood, or a horrific experience, can learn to use their taint for fun or profit.

links.title: Abyssal Disciple
links.snippet: The chosen ones of demon lords take their fiendish powers to a new level, unleashing havoc on the lands of the living and transforming in the end into demons in their own right.

links.title: Aquatic Disciple
links.snippet: Those spellcasters who devote their lives to defend water creatures and emulate their abilities forsake their earthly heritages to become aquatic disciples.

links.title: Arcane Disciple
links.snippet: The children of magic, descendants of scholar families, those who breathe magic like others breathe air, become arcane disciples.

links.title: Celestial Disciple
links.snippet: Those who were chosen by the Upper Planes denizens to join their ranks, either for their blood, devotion or noble deeds, become true heavenly forces in the lands of mortals.

links.title: Destined Disciple
links.snippet: Destined disciples are called to be more than they are, more than they believe to be. Every step in life brings them nearer to their promised fate, and they choose to fully embrace this journey.

links.title: Elemental Disciple
links.snippet: Creatures born with the blood or benediction of natural forces can end fusing themselves with the world’s energies, either on the mortal plane or beyond it.

links.title: Fey Disciple
links.snippet: The children of the woods, descendants of faerie creatures or born from eldritch energies and spells, become one with the First World when they mature.

links.title: Infernal Disciple
links.snippet: The spawn of infernal pits, aspirant archdevils, or the most faithful dark priests receive power from Hell to corrupt and tempt mortals.

links.title: Maestro Disciple

links.title: Phoenix Disciple
links.snippet: Virtuous mortals who dedicate themselves to good and fire magic and try to emulate the mighty firebirds can be accepted as phoenix disciples.

links.title: Undead Disciple
links.snippet: Children born from dead mothers, dhampirs, masters of undead, priests of death gods, all of these can answer the call of the grave and become undead disciples.

links.title: Verdant Disciple
links.snippet: A child of the forest can eventually become part of the forest, living on lymph and sunlight and becoming increasingly similar to the trees she loves. Verdant disciples are often the fiercest protectors of the wilderness.

links.snippet: Furious at her small stature, the pint-sized rager seeks imaginary revenge on any who lord over her.

links.snippet: The righteous berserker is infuriated by evil and uses any means to cleanse it from the land.

links.title: Cave Mother, Sorceress of Secrets
links.snippet: She who discovered fire, Cave Mother grants those who show her proper respect the flames of the first fire and the basic means of survival.

links.title: General Hessant, Patron of Lost Souls
links.snippet: Commander of an empire and leader of countless men, General Hessant grants able warriors his skills and punishments.

links.title: Sevnoir, the Meandering Mastiff
links.snippet: Sevnoir is said to be the vengeful mother of all shadow mastiffs. She grants those whom she deems worthy of being her master the powers of the fabled shadow hounds.

links.title: Lady Jarah, Mistress of Many Faces
links.snippet: She is the woman of a thousand tales who is fated to outlive all mortal men. Those who please Lady Jarah become living legends themselves, able to reweave reality through storytelling.

links.title: Mute Sylvus, Sole Survivor
links.snippet: Mute Sylvus speaks to no one, but those who manage to call forth this troubled survivor are gifted with his haunting prowess.

links.title: Tyrant Cromwell, the Black Knight
links.snippet: Formerly a paladin, now a tyrant, Cromwell grants those whom he calls worthy the power to smite his foes with otherworldly anger and loathing.

links.title: Ubro, the Blind Hospitaler
links.snippet: Ubro the Blind bore a demon’s curse as he crossed the lands offering healing. To those whom he deems worthy, Ubro bestows the very boons his demon gifted upon him.

links.title: Muse Istago, Painter of Paradox
links.snippet: Istago was a tragic painter driven to insanity by the relentless demands of his talent. He grants worthy artists the ability to repaint reality itself.

links.title: N’alyia, the First Vampire
links.snippet: First among vampires, the dreaded N’alyia grants her mortal binders the abilities of a vampire in order to whet their tongues with temptations of undeath and blood.

links.title: Vandrae, Drowess Poisontouch
links.snippet: This sadistic drow assassin killed friend and foe alike. Vandrae grants the guile of an assassin to those who strike her as cold and alien as she was in life.

links.title: Xalen D’Marek, Archivist of Fell Secrets
links.snippet: He is the mad steward of a million forbidden secrets and ancient lore. Those with a desire for learning are granted with the Archivist’s vast intellect and power.

links.title: Fey Baraddu, the Beast in the Woods
links.snippet: The gods reduced this beloved fey to a savage beast. Baraddu grants those who wish to become one with the natural world the ability to take on the aspects of the wild.

links.title: Gulguthriana, the Glutton
links.snippet: She who thrives in filth, Gulguthriana is the first of the otyughs. She grants boons of rot and decay to those who recall the greatness that the otyughs once claimed.

links.title: Hexus, the Living Curse
links.snippet: A curse made animate, Hexus scours the world searching for his purpose and rewarding those who give him one.

links.title: Loh’moi, the Mad Geometer
links.snippet: A natural-born genius, Loh’moi wished to bend time and space to better his family’s life. Loh’moi provides his knowledge to those who prove their intelligence to him.

links.title: Arturius, the Sleeping King
links.snippet: This legendary king was dethroned by a usurper, his bastard son. Arturius grants his fabled skill at arms to those whom he deems worthy of his inheritance.

links.title: Dagon, Tentacles from the Deep
links.snippet: This terror floats beyond the laws of space and time. Dagon grants his worthy binders the power to survive in hostile places and manipulate the flow of time.

links.title: Dark Blood, the Rakshasa Prince
links.snippet: The spirit Dark Blood consists of six souls that bartered for power and now answer the call of those who seek the same.

links.title: Vodavox, the Hive Mind
links.snippet: The ever-dueling minds of Vodavox once commanded a legion of hosts before collapsing. Vodavox grants aberrant powers to those who revel in chaos.

links.title: Demos Kalagos, Sworn Enemy of Time
links.snippet: The one who tricked time and was tricked in return, Demos grants those who prove themselves as tricksters the ability to trick others with time.

links.title: Jayna Warlock, Traveler of Worlds
links.snippet: A master of elements and traveler of reality, Jayna provides those who share in her beliefs an array of elemental power.

links.title: Serapith, the Scouring Light
links.snippet: The angel who sought to end mortal life, Serapith grants those who prove that they understand the necessity of his work the power to scour life from the world around them.

links.title: Mare Loviatha, Ice Queen
links.snippet: Loviatha tried to manipulate her family into making her queen and almost succeeded. “Mare” Loviatha will bestow the powers of her icy home to anyone who worships her as the queen she deserves to be.

links.title: Musha’Vadu, the Shadow-Bones Emperor
links.snippet: A vain soul who exists only in darkness, Musha’Vadu grants the powers of the dark to those who seek vanity and decadence before all else.

links.title: Portenta, Seer of the Orphic Eye
links.snippet: The seer who ignored the divine order, Portenta grants those who seek her spirit the ability to see beyond the curtains of reality.

links.title: Essek Avik, the Twins Rejoined
links.snippet: Brothers united by suffering eternal, Essek and Avix grant power to those who distract them from their torments.

links.title: Evening Star, Bloody Mist of the Hills
links.snippet: It which is not from our world, Evening Star grants its aspects to those who show that they are willing to let it play once more.

links.title: Young Kiros, Author of Sedition
links.snippet: Young Kiros was an idealistic revolutionary whose unjust actions against a king cost him dearly. Kiros grants power to those who wish to crusade for equality.

links.title: Daeminthos, Crystal Eye of the Mind
links.snippet: The mind who is broken, Daeminthos grants psychic powers to those who manage to acquire his fragmented attention.

links.title: King Mutaros, Vengeance Unfulfilled
links.snippet: The king who was ended by his own son, Mutaros grants his puissant skill-of-arms to anyone willing to fulfill his vengeance.

links.title: Malebolge Moors, 13 Traitors of Hell
links.snippet: The spirits of 13 fallen angels melded and merged together by the fires of a devil’s belly. The Malebolge Moors grant their power to any who can recall their existence.

links.title: Access Higher Chakra Slot
links.snippet: You gain the ability to bind veils to a higher chakra, increasing their power and versatility.

links.title: Access Low Chakra Slot
links.snippet: You gain the ability to bind veils to a low chakra, increasing their power and versatility.

links.title: Access Middle Chakra Slot
links.snippet: You open up one of your body’s centers of power, allowing you to bind a veil or a magic item to that chakra.

links.title: Akasha-Infused Spells (Akashic)
links.snippet: You gain the ability to invest akasha directly into the spells you cast.

links.title: Akashic Augmentation
links.snippet: You can augment a psionic power with your chakra energy rather than mental energy.

links.title: Akashic Charge (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can channel akasha to amplify your blows when charging. When you make a charge attack while this feat is active, your weapon is briefly encased in a thin sheath of akashic energy.

links.title: Body-Bound Mind (Akashic)
links.snippet: The energy of akasha courses through your mind, increasing your mental capacity.

links.title: Chakra Power (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can take your body’s toughness and natural resilience and use it to fuel attacks whose power exceeds mere physical strength.

links.title: Chakra Strike (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can channel akasha into your precision-based attacks, damaging your foe’s inner energy and body simultaneously.

links.title: Chakra Targeting (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can focus akashic energy into your ranged attacks, dealing more damage and improving your aim.

links.title: Chakra-Enhanced Fortitude (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can use akasha to strengthen your blood and harden your internal organs. You boost your ability to resist effects that would adversely affect your health.

links.title: Daevic Rage (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can channel akasha to enhance your rage. When you do so, eldritch energy bleeds from your body with every wound you take, shrouding you in power that harms your foes and shields you from harmful magics.

links.title: Divine Essence (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can channel positive or negative energy to imbue yourself with akasha.

links.title: Enhanced Capacity
links.snippet: Your capacity for channeling akasha allows you to maintain more essence in a single veil.

links.title: Essence Expertise (Akashic)
links.snippet: By achieving a special meditative state, you can focus your essence to grant yourself akasha-enhanced defenses.

links.title: Essence Focus (Akashic)
links.snippet: The blending of akasha and psionics you have mastered gives you unusual focus and recovery.

links.title: Essence of Movement (Akashic)
links.snippet: You flow through the battlefield, nimbly evading the blows of your enemies.

links.title: Essence of Recovery (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can channel akasha to enhance your ability to heal. When you use your akasha-infused healing class feature, your body and hands hum with eldritch energy.

links.title: Essence of the Immortal (Akashic)
links.snippet: You fortify your heart and lungs with akasha, making you even more durable.

links.title: Essence Rejection
links.snippet: A strange defect or racial quirk has left you utterly devoid of even the vaguest hints of akashic energy, and your chakra energy is unusually resistant to akashic effects.

links.title: Extra Essence
links.snippet: You are better able to harness your personal store of akasha.

links.title: Focused Critical (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can focus your spirit into your weapon attacks, dealing more damage with successful critical strikes.

links.title: Life Bond (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can transfer your own vital essence into another.

links.title: Pistolero’s Bind (Akashic)
links.snippet: With a flick of the wrist you repair your damaged weapon with a thin layer of akasha.

links.title: Powerful Throw (Combat)
links.snippet: You can leverage your great strength to control the flight of your thrown weapons.

links.title: Shape Veil
links.snippet: You gain the ability to shape a single veil.

links.title: Shared Veil
links.snippet: You can share a veil with an ally with which you have a special bond.

links.title: Tainted Chakra (Akashic)
links.snippet: Your chakra is tainted with the energy of some dark entity or shadowed bloodline, giving your veils and essence abilities a sinister cast.

links.title: Treewalker (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can run up trees and other living vertical surfaces as though they were solid ground.

links.title: Twin Veil
links.snippet: One of your chakra slots becomes more receptive and capable of sustaining more akasha than would normally be possible.

links.title: Veil-Touched Nemesis (Akashic)
links.snippet: Akashic energy imbues your attacks, enabling your allies to more easily exploit your enemy’s weaknesses.

links.title: Veil-Woven Channel (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can enhance the power of your channel energy ability with akasha-focused power.

links.title: Veilbound Metamagic
links.snippet: You can use essence to enhance your spells.

links.title: Veilbound Resilience (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can use akasha to seal your wounds, causing the wounds to throb with eldritch energy while they mend.

links.title: View Energy
links.snippet: You can imbue your eyes with akashic energy, allowing you to see the life energy that flows through living things.

links.title: Weaver’s Reflexes (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can use akasha to boost your ability to avoid harm by giving yourself enhanced reaction speed.

links.title: Wildclaw Chakra (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can channel akasha to enhance your combat prowess while wild shaped.

links.title: Will of the Daeva (Akashic)
links.snippet: You can use akasha to boost your willpower, giving you newfound strength of purpose.

links.title: Great Cleave (Combat)
links.snippet: You can strike many adjacent foes with a single blow.

links.title: Arcane Armor Training (Combat)
links.snippet: You have learned how to cast spells while wearing armor.

links.title: Spirited Charge (Combat)
links.snippet: Your mounted charge attacks deal a tremendous amount of damage.

links.title: Snatch Arrows (Combat)
links.snippet: Instead of knocking an arrow or ranged attack aside, you can catch it in mid-flight.

links.title: Shield Specialization (Combat)
links.snippet: You have mastered the use of one type of shield.

links.title: Ride-by Attack (Combat)
links.snippet: While mounted and charging, you can move, strike at a foe, and then continue moving.

links.title: Greater Disarm (Combat)
links.snippet: You can knock weapons far from an enemy’s grasp.

links.title: Greater Bull Rush (Combat)
links.snippet: Your bull rush attacks throw enemies off balance.

links.title: The Pirate Crew
links.snippet: There is a defined hierarchy on board of a pirate ship, which follows the most important functions. This hierarchy is not geared towards who has more say on board, but what the chain of command is in any particular situation.

links.snippet: A coastline or seashore is the area where land meets the sea or ocean. A precise line that can be called a coastline cannot be determined due to the dynamic nature of tides. The term “coastal zone” can be used instead, which is a spatial…

links.title: (Bestiary) Terrain: Aquatic/Water
links.snippet: Aquatic terrain is the least hospitable to most PCs, because they can’t breathe there. Aquatic terrain doesn’t offer the variety that land terrain does. The ocean floor holds many marvels, including undersea analogues of any of the terrain…

links.snippet: Guns are not strangers to fantasy. The earliest authors of fantasy and weird fiction often included guns in their stories. Heroes like Burroughs’s John Carter or Howard’s Solomon Kane carried pistols alongside their swords, and it’s hard…

links.title: Cave Crawler
links.snippet: A bone-white humanoid creature huddles naked before you. It seems to be roughly the size of a gnome, with frighteningly gnomish features save for pupil-less eyes and elongated forearms ending in long-fingered claws. Its feet also seem very…

links.title: Corrupted Rager
links.snippet: Barbarians who have been trapped in a hostile magical environment—the nascent energies of the plane have inexorably changed them, and fuel their strength.

links.title: Dark Acolyte
links.snippet: Unlike most monks, these adherents are dedicated to a specific set of beliefs dictating they must manipulate people to achieve their goals and only through careful wordplay can they enforce their will.

links.title: Divine Morale
links.snippet: A cleric must choose the Protection domain as one of their domains or one of the Protection subdomains if they don’t worship a deity. If they worship a deity, the deity must have Protection as a domain.

links.title: Injection Chemist
links.snippet: The injection chemist is an archetype of the alchemist class.

links.title: Iron Song
links.snippet: Iron song bards use their music to inspire even constructs.

links.title: Oath of Greed
links.snippet: Antipaladins who embrace a lavish lifestyle; these individuals want more, more , MORE ! And their bottomless hunger for fame and fortune leads them down a dark and endless spiral.

links.title: Cthonic Bloodline
links.snippet: Tainted by the powers that lie beyond the dark tapestry, powers of the void flow through you like an accursed disease.

links.title: Dinosaur Bloodline
links.snippet: Sorcerers from tribal societies often develop powers from the local fauna, in this case the large and intimidating dinosaurs surrounding the region.

links.title: Ranged Combatant
links.snippet: The ranged combatant dragoon style’s feat selection are as follows: point blank shot , precise shot , rapid reload , snap shot , rapid shot , and manyshot .

links.title: Two-Weapon Style
links.snippet: The two-weapon fighting dragoon style’s feat selection are as follows: two-weapon fighting , improved two-weapon fighting , greater two-weapon fighting , double slice , two-weapon rend , and two-weapon defense .

links.title: Imprinted Arm – Imprints
links.snippet: Imprinted Arm – Imprints Imprints are similar to Bloodlines which are gained by the Imprinted Arm class . Each one varies in its power and style.

links.title: Driven Techniques
links.snippet: Driven Techniques Name of Technique Prerequisites Benefit Advanced Eagle Eye Steam Blade 12 Expend 2 uses of Eagle Eye to give an enemy a weakness to an element. All Knowing – Expend a use of Eagle Eye to make a Knowledge check on an…

links.title: Steam Gun
links.snippet: While most steam blades specialize in up close and personal martial combat, the steam gun chooses to use an abnormal and advanced firearm to slay his enemies with ease.

links.title: Inspired Punisher
links.snippet: While the normal steam blade tends to show off with his blade work and abilities, the inspired punisher seeks to use his cunning to show enemies the truest form of pain.

links.title: Rapier Adept
links.snippet: Some swordsman do indeed focus on the finesse of a rapier, but not all dedicate themselves solely to the rapier quite like the rapier adept.

links.title: Intellectual Item
links.snippet: By their side is the only companion they’ll need in life: a sword that talks.

links.title: Boastful Champion
links.snippet: Warriors who enjoy the adrenaline of battle, these battlers channel the force of their personality through a crowd, or simply through his allies.

links.title: Stratagem
links.snippet: Tacticians learn new techniques and ways of aiding allies in times of need, as well as strategies they can use against the enemy. At 1st level and every odd levels thereafter, the tactician gains a new Stratagem. Unless specifically noted,…

links.title: Enchanting Avenger
links.snippet: Starting Wealth : 4d6 × 10 gp (average 140 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

links.title: Infected Host
links.snippet: The Infected Host is an individual infected with a ‘curse’ of sorts, giving them an arm with special powers.

links.title: Omdura
links.snippet: Acting as divine warriors, omduras embody the tenets of their gods and serve as divine vessels. In the world of Asunda, omdura means “leader of souls” omdaris the masculine form and omdurais the feminine form. As Niobe is a woman, the…

links.title: Special Abilities
links.snippet: The following special abilities include rules commonly used by a number of creatures, spells, and traps.

links.title: Magic Weapons
links.snippet: A magic weapon is enhanced to strike more truly and deliver more damage. Magic weapons have enhancement bonuses ranging from +1 to +5. They apply these bonuses to both attack and damage rolls when used in combat. All magic weapons are also…

links.title: Demonthrall
links.snippet: Those who have dedicated their lives to the service of demons may be initiated into the ranks of the demonthralls.

links.title: Murk and Gloom
links.snippet: School transmutation ; Level cleric 1, druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 2

links.title: Solid Ice
links.snippet: This spell may only be cast upon a body of water that is at least 3 feet deep. You create either a single continuous sheet of fresh water ice that forms on the surface of the water and has a depth of at least 5 feet, or multiple bergs of…

links.title: Adamant Guardian
links.snippet: This huge, marble statue of an angel watches its surroundings with unflinching vigilance.

links.title: Aeons
links.snippet: Aeons are a race of neutral outsiders who roam the planes maintaining the balance of reality.

links.title: Alchemeleon
links.snippet: This lizard-shaped construct is made of a mirror-like, silvery substance.

links.title: Angel, Cherub
links.snippet: The body of this four-winged humanoid is covered in numerous eyes. Floating around it are the disembodied heads of a bull, an eagle, and a lion.

links.title: Archons
links.snippet: Archons are a race of celestials, or good outsiders, native to lawful good-aligned outer planes.

links.title: Astral Jelly
links.snippet: This jellyfish is the size of a human head. A prominent, hourglass-shaped organ can be seen through its semi-translucent flesh.

links.title: Biolith, Crystalworm
links.snippet: This enormous worm is made of light blue crystal, and is covered with numerous, sharp spines.

links.title: Biolith, Razorback
links.snippet: This urchin-like lump of living crystal has a relatively small body covered in enormous spines.

links.title: Bone Cage
links.snippet: As tall as a human, this over-sized, disembodied rib cage floats through the air. Having no sternum, it snaps its jagged ribs like teeth on a pair of jaws.

links.title: Brass Cat
links.snippet: The skin of this feline appears to made of molten brass.

links.title: Brownie, Black-Eyed
links.snippet: This pale, child-like creature has solid black eyes.

links.title: Brownie, Swamp
links.snippet: This tiny, slender humanoid has a lotus blossom where it’s hair would otherwise be.

links.title: Chaos Ooze
links.snippet: This puddle of sludge constantly changes color.

links.title: Chimera, Primordial
links.snippet: This creature resembles a dragon with the hindquarters of a goat.

links.title: Crypt Thing, Crypt Warden
links.snippet: This animate, mummified corpse has glowing motes of flame in its empty eye sockets.

links.title: Daemons
links.snippet: Daemons are neutral evil outsiders that eat souls and thrive on disaster and ruin.

links.title: Dazzle Cane
links.snippet: Sitting atop of tangle of tendrils, this cluster of reed-like stalks is topped with glittery, gossamer leaves.

links.title: Demons
links.snippet: Demons are chaotic evil outsiders that call the Abyss their home.

links.title: Devil’s Longhorn
links.snippet: This large, long-horned bovine has bulging muscles, steel hooves, and a flaming brand on its flank.

links.title: Devils
links.snippet: Devils are lawful evil outsiders that hail from the plane of Hell.

links.title: Dinosaur, Compsognathus Swarm
links.snippet: Dozens of tiny, bipedal dinosaurs leap over one another in their enthusiasm to reach and devour their prey.

links.title: Dragon Sovereign
links.snippet: This titanic, humanoid dragon has crimson scales. It wields a long spear that ends in a jagged obsidian blade.

links.title: Dragon Turtle, Great Wyrm
links.snippet: This small, rocky island moves, revealing itself to be an enormous creature resembling a snapping turtle.

links.title: Dragons, True
links.snippet: True dragons are among the mightiest of all dragons.

links.title: Drake, Riding
links.snippet: Slender and graceful, this wingless dragon is the size of a horse.

links.title: Dream Angler
links.snippet: This enormous fish has an oversized maw. A silvery, cord-like tendril extends from its forehead to dangle in front of its face.

links.title: Dryad, Winter
links.snippet: This strange crone has flesh that resembles gnarled wood and unkempt, snow-white hair.

links.title: Eater of Years
links.snippet: Resembling a centipede with a sucker-like mouth, this creature transforms into an animate pile of sand when moving.

links.title: Elemental Savants
links.snippet: Elemental savants are sorcerers native to the elemental planes.

links.title: Elemental-Infused
links.snippet: This tall, incredibly-muscular woman froths at the mouth, her eyes burning with insane rage.

links.title: Elementals
links.snippet: Each elemental is a being composed of a single substance. True elementals are outsiders native to various elemental planes; the elementals known as alchementals are oozes native to the Material Plane.

links.title: Ether Strider
links.snippet: This spider-like creature is woven from semi-solid, smoke-like strands, its wispy body loosely encased in a patchwork exoskeleton of armored crimson plates.

links.title: Exothermic Ooze
links.snippet: This pool of animate, multicolored slime lashes out with a grasping pseudopod.

links.title: Flail Snail, Undead
links.snippet: This horse-sized snail has a mottled, brown shell and four tentacles on its head, each ending in a humanoid skull.

links.title: Fog Hound
links.snippet: This small, cloud-like creature has a shape that resembles a cross between a dog and a fox.

links.title: Fused Swarm
links.snippet: The creatures in a fused swarm are conjoined into a single, fleshy mass.

links.title: Gaunt Man
links.snippet: This tall, slender creature is wrapped in a dark cloak that barely conceals the tentacles writhing beneath it. The creature’s face is nothing but a giant maw.

links.title: Ghast Worm
links.snippet: The stench of rotting meat accompanies this bloated, horse-sized worm.

links.title: Ghostflower Seed
links.snippet: This luminous ball of light drifts lazily through the air. Variances in the orb’s luminosity produce a vaguely skull-like image within its interior.

links.title: Ghosts
links.snippet: Ghosts are restless, incorporeal undead.

links.title: Golems
links.snippet: Golems are magically-created automatons of great power.

links.title: Gremlins
links.snippet: Well known for their mischievous natures, their nasty senses of humor, and their destructive habits, the fey creatures known as gremlins rightfully earn their reputations as cruel pranksters and sadistic saboteurs.

links.title: Grue, Shadow
links.snippet: This vaguely-humanoid, bat-like creature is made of living darkness.

links.title: Gun Titan
links.snippet: This mechanical colossus of bulky, armored plates has multi-barreled canons where its hands should be.

links.title: Hag, Qallupilluk
links.snippet: This monstrous crone with scaly green skin and wicked claws reeks of sulfur.

links.title: Halfblood
links.snippet: This gray-skinned creature has the body of a winged lion, the head and torso of a woman, and a glaring third eye in the center of its forehead.

links.title: Harpy, Dirgesinger
links.snippet: This wild-looking crone has taloned feet and black-feathered wings.

links.title: Hell Beetle
links.snippet: This flame-red beetle has gripping pincers and an over-sized maw.

links.title: Hell Rider
links.snippet: This gaunt, spectral figure sits astride an equally ephemeral horse. Both horse and rider have delirious looks in their eyes.

links.title: Hivespawn
links.snippet: This insectoid creature resembles a vaguely-humanoid scorpion without a stinger. It has scythe-like blades instead of pincers and a row of spines along its back.

links.title: Hooden Horse
links.snippet: The head of this gaunt, white-shrouded humanoid resembles a horse’s skull.

links.title: Humming Dragon
links.snippet: The wings of this tiny dragon beat so quickly, they can barely be seen.

links.title: Ijiraat
links.snippet: This squat, muscular humanoid resembles a hairless dwarf.

links.title: Intellect Parasite
links.snippet: This creature resembles a disembodied human brain that has sprouted four short, clawed legs.

links.title: Lesovik
links.snippet: This man has cloven feet, curling horns, and a mane of living vegetation in place of hair.

links.title: Lich, Bardic
links.snippet: This sagely, skeletal figure wears finery and carries a mandolin.

links.title: Living Rift
links.snippet: This web-like pattern of shifting, disembodied cracks dances through the air like so much lightning.

links.title: Living Zombie (3pp)
links.snippet: The man before you is armed with a short sword. He wears leather armor and a vacant expression.

links.title: Lurker Behind
links.snippet: This vaguely humanoid creature resembles a trio of fused snakes. The heads and tails of the smaller snakes serve as the arms and legs of the larger one.

links.title: Magpie, Monstrous
links.snippet: This long-tailed, white-bellied avian resembles an over-sized crow.

links.title: Medusa, Half-Blind
links.snippet: This slender woman with a crown of snakes for hair has cloudy, milky-white eyes.

links.title: Mercurian
links.snippet: The clay-like flesh of this mutable creature constantly flows, but always returns to a vaguely humanoid shape, allowing it to wield its gear as if it were a solid humanoid.

links.title: Mimic, Animal
links.snippet: The animal before you melts into a blob of mutable flesh.

links.title: Mindslaver Mold, Greater
links.snippet: This patch of filthy, green mold grows in twisting, chain-link pattern.

links.title: Mindworm
links.snippet: This dull gray serpent has patches of pink, hair-like tendrils where its jaw meets its skull.

links.title: Monkey, Flying
links.snippet: This small, evil-looking primate sports feathered wings and vicious claws.

links.title: Mummy Beetle Swarm
links.snippet: Thousands of eerily silent beetles surge forth in a terrifying wave of dark bodies.

links.title: Mummy, Minotaur
links.snippet: This large, mummified humanoid with cloven hooves has the head of a skeletal bull.

links.title: Nightmare, Crawling
links.snippet: This inky black horse has four giant arms instead of legs, arrayed about its body like the limbs of a spider. Each ends in a hoof surrounded by fingers, as if tightly gripped in a large hand.

links.title: Orb of Eyes
links.snippet: This large, hovering ball of flesh is featureless, save for an enormous, gaping maw.

links.title: Origami Familiar
links.snippet: This life-sized, hawk-shaped construct is made of folded paper.

links.title: Patchwork Servitor
links.snippet: This humanoid with ashen grey flesh is held together with stitches.Various tools and other objects are grafted onto its body.

links.title: Phantasmagor
links.snippet: The face of this spectral humanoid is obscured by a ghostly porcelain mask.

links.title: Phantom Beetle
links.snippet: The size of a house-cat, this is dull grey beetle with feathery antennae seems to be staring in your direction with its dead, black eyes.

links.title: Platnumatl
links.snippet: This stout, serpent-like creature has a pair of vestigial arms, platinum-colored scales, and a plume of golden feathers.

links.title: Poltergeist, Greater
links.snippet: Those who can see the invisible see an spectral creature that resembles a bloated, mutilated corpse.

links.title: Primeval Beast
links.snippet: This enormous, bipedal dinosaur has undersized forearms and an over-sized, fang-filled mouth.

links.title: Proteans
links.snippet: Proteans are serpentine outsiders of pure chaos.

links.title: Protothelid
links.snippet: This gaunt, long-limbed quadruped has huge, soulless eyes and a toothless maw from which dangle four writhing tongues.

links.title: Psychopomp Swarm
links.snippet: Thousands of tiny birds swarm through the air, pecking at everything in their path.

links.title: Púca
links.snippet: This brightly-colored pony has soft, cherubic features.

links.title: Quantum Cat
links.snippet: This large cat flickers into and out of existence, its flesh alternately rotting and untouched by decay.

links.title: Rainbow Serpent
links.snippet: This snake-like dragon has scales that shimmer with rainbow-colored light.

links.title: Rakshasa, Demonspawned
links.snippet: This bestial biped, whose fingers bend away from its palms, has an appearance combining the features of various, mismatched animals.

links.title: Renegade Pigment
links.snippet: This blob of shifting colors constantly roils and flows.

links.title: River Thane
links.snippet: Wearing a crown and wielding a trident, this statuesque humanoid has blue-green skin and hair like seaweed.

links.title: Rogue Star
links.snippet: Behold: an enormous ball of fire as bright as the Sun.

links.title: Rogue Viscera
links.snippet: This clump of mismatched, disembodied organs crawls about on slender, vein-like tendrils.

links.title: Runeshell
links.snippet: As tall as a dwarf, this crab-like creature is has oversized pincers and a carapace covered with strange runes.

links.title: Sephirah
links.snippet: A sephirah (plural: sephiroth) is a living vessel for benevolent divine power beyond mortal comprehension.

links.title: Serpentaur
links.snippet: This creature has the upper body of a beautiful elf and the lower body of a large snake.

links.title: Shadow Wisp
links.snippet: An inky ball of darkness bobs and weaves through the air.

links.title: Shadowmite Swarm
links.snippet: Observers able to see the invisible realize that nearby surfaces are covered in a carpet of miniscule vermin, each no larger than a grain of sand.

links.title: Shantak, Juvenile
links.snippet: The size of a horse, this scaly, bird-like creature has a vaguely equine head.

links.title: Shrew
links.snippet: The size of a pony, this creature resembles an enormous mouse with a narrow nose, short legs, and tusk-like teeth.

links.title: Shrimp, Anomalous
links.snippet: This long, narrow crustacean has tiny legs and fin-like projections on the side of its body. Its eyes are situated on stalks, and it sports a pair of short, barbed arms flanking its mouth.

links.title: Shrimp, Monstrous
links.snippet: This long, narrow crustacean has tiny legs and fin-like projections on the side of its body. Its eyes are situated on stalks, and it sports a pair of short, barbed arms flanking its mouth.

links.title: Silent Creeper
links.snippet: This mass of leafy vines slithers across the ground like a writhing swarm of vipers.

links.title: Sinpurged
links.snippet: This androgynous, hairless humanoid is covered in so many scars, the fact that it yet lives is a small miracle. Its bones are twisted, its skin melted, and its eyes little more than empty pits.

links.title: Skitterling
links.snippet: This slender, hairless creature has grey skin, bulbous eyes, and no mouth.

links.title: Skunk Ape
links.snippet: This small, black-furred ape has large eyes and a foul stench.

links.title: Skyfish Swarm
links.snippet: Thousands of diminutive, translucent jellyfish swirl through the air, crackling with electricity and smelling of ozone.

links.title: Slithering Master
links.snippet: What at first appeared to be a streak of moisture rises up, revealing itself to be a transparent, serpentine ooze.

links.title: Smoke Fiend
links.snippet: An enormous cloud of roiling smoke flies through the air with willful intent.

links.title: Snap Vine
links.snippet: As long as a human is tall, this thorn-covered vine slithers across the ground like a snake.

links.title: Sovereign Fungus
links.snippet: A mass of black tendrils erupts from the ground.

links.title: Spellwraith
links.snippet: To those that can see it, this ghostly creature appears to be a humanoid shape comprised of colorful vapor.

links.title: Spider Blossom
links.snippet: This human-sized, black-flowered shrub skitters about on leg-like roots in a spider-like manner.

links.title: Spiderrat
links.snippet: The size of a wagon, this creature resembles a rat with spider legs.

links.title: Sporebeetle Swarm
links.snippet: This swarm of flying, brown beetles is cloaked in a cloud of yellow-green dust.

links.title: Starmetal Wyrm
links.snippet: This sleek, raptor-like dragon has polished, adamantine scales.

links.title: Thoqqua, Cherufe
links.snippet: The skin of this enormous worm is made of red-hot, metallic plates.

links.title: Thread Swarm
links.snippet: This large carpet of tangled threads tumbles forth like an avalanche of unsewn fabric.

links.title: Tonal, Guardian
links.snippet: This jaguar-like feline has fur the color of the daytime sky.

links.title: Tripod Toadstool
links.snippet: This large, table-like mushroom scuttles about on three trunk-like legs, trailing a whip-like tail.

links.title: Tunnel Runner
links.snippet: Made from the hollowed-out exoskeleton of an enormous centipede, this construct is reinforced with bands of steel and animated by steam-powered clockworks.

links.title: Unicorn Fish
links.snippet: This colorful, one-horned fish bristles with long, hairlike tendrils.

links.title: Unicorn, Twilight
links.snippet: This creature resembles a dark grey horse with a single black horn on its forehead.

links.title: Unstable Creature
links.snippet: This humanoid mass of flesh constantly bubbles and churns.

links.title: Vampires
links.snippet: Vampires are a type of undead that feed on blood and life energy.

links.title: Wandering Rock
links.snippet: This squat, vaguely-humanoid rock formation sprouts a pair of arms which end huge, boulder-like fists.

links.title: Water Panther
links.snippet: The size of a small pony, this black-furred feline has slick, oily skin.

links.title: Weeping Demon
links.snippet: Seemingly carved from stone, this humanoid figure resembles a monstrous, winged demon. It’s eyes shed continual tears of blood.

links.title: Dorjes
links.snippet: A dorje is a slender crystal that contains a single power . Each dorje has 50 charges when created, and each charge expended allows one use of that power . A dorje that runs out of charges is just a simple crystal.

links.title: Power Stones
links.snippet: A power stone stores a power (or collection of powers). A stored power can be used only once, “flushing” the stone. Using a power stone is basically like manifesting a power .

links.title: Psicrowns

links.title: Psionic Tattoos
links.snippet: Psionic tattoos are designs scribed on the skin that manifest powers on their wearers. The wearer doesn’t get to make any decisions about the tattoo’s effect—the manifester who scribed it has already done so.

links.snippet: This is a catchall category for any psionic item that doesn’t fall into the other groups. Anyone can use a universal item (unless specified otherwise in the description).

links.snippet: The following is a list of all the Touch of Loss options available to a Ghoul.

links.title: Action
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch renders the target detached from his surroundings, unable to act.

links.title: Anytouch
links.snippet: This Touch of Loss can emulate the effect of almost any other Touch of Loss

links.title: Awareness
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch dulls the target’s senses and presence of mind.

links.title: Balance
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch robs the target of its sense of balance.

links.title: Confidence
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch erodes the target’s confidence, awakening inner fears.

links.title: Coordination
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch robs the target of its ability to move as desired.

links.title: Defenses
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch makes the subject more vulnerable to incoming attacks.

links.title: Force
links.snippet: The ghoul can make the target wither visibly, robbing it of its lifeforce.

links.title: Health
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch spreads sickness in the target’s body.

links.title: Hearing
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch makes the subject lose its hearing.

links.title: Integrity
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch opens grievous wounds on the subject’s body.

links.title: Mind
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch tampers with the target’s sanity.

links.title: Muscle
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch disrupts the target’s muscles, undermining its ability to move.

links.title: Resilience
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch makes the subject more vulnerable to occult powers.

links.title: Senses
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch makes the target lose consciousness, fainting immediately.

links.title: Stamina
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch robs the target of its lifeforce.

links.title: Structure
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch undermines the subject’s very physical structure.

links.title: Wholeness
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch opens wounds on the target’s skin.

links.title: Youth
links.snippet: The ghoul’s touch robs the target of its remaining years of life.

links.snippet: Base effect: All allies within 30 feet completely negate the effects of all spells, spell-like and supernatural abilities on a successful save. This maestro performance can negate 1 effect per ally per day, plus 1 for every 5 siren levels…

links.title: Chanceweaver (Cubomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Chanceweavers are cubomancers who have learned to manipulate the fabric of probability itself, weaving strands of luck into intricate patterns that bend reality to their will.

links.title: Chaos Gambler (Cubomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Chaos Gamblers revel in the unpredictable nature of their magic, pushing the boundaries of chance and embracing the wild fluctuations of probability to devastating effect.

links.title: Fractal Sage (Cubomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Fractal Sages delve deep into the mathematical patterns underlying reality, using their understanding of complex geometries to enhance their magical abilities.

links.title: Probability Thief (Cubomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Probability Thieves are cunning cubomancers who have learned to steal luck from others, manipulating fate to their advantage.

links.title: Dreamscape Architect (Dreambinder Archetype)
links.snippet: Dreamscape Architects specialize in manipulating the fabric of dreams to create and shape entire realms within the Dreamtime. They excel at crafting elaborate illusions and pocket dimensions, often using their abilities to create safe…

links.title: Nightmare Weaver (Dreambinder Archetype)
links.snippet: Nightmare Weavers delve into the darker aspects of the Dreamtime, harnessing fear and negative emotions to create powerful effects. They specialize in manipulating the subconscious fears of their targets, often serving as skilled…

links.title: Prophetic Dreamer (Dreambinder Archetype)
links.snippet: Prophetic Dreamers focus on harnessing the predictive power of dreams, gaining insights into possible futures and using this knowledge to guide their actions. They excel at divination and can provide valuable strategic advice to their…

links.title: Reverie Channeler (Dreambinder Archetype)
links.snippet: Reverie Channelers specialize in drawing power directly from the Dreamtime, blurring the lines between spells and psionic powers. They excel at adapting their abilities on the fly and can access a wider range of magical effects than…

links.title: Mycelial Shaper (Fungomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Mycelial Shapers are fungomancers who have developed an extraordinary ability to manipulate and shape fungal matter. They excel at creating complex structures and tools from fungi, often serving as builders, artisans, or siege engineers in…

links.title: Rotweaver (Fungomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Rotweavers are fungomancers who have mastered the intricate dance of decay and renewal. They specialize in manipulating the processes of decomposition and rebirth, often serving as guardians of the natural cycle in areas where the…

links.title: Spore Sovereign (Fungomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Spore Sovereigns are fungomancers who have developed an extraordinary affinity for fungal spores. They can manipulate spores with unparalleled precision, using them for a variety of effects ranging from communication to combat.

links.title: Truffle Hunter (Fungomancer Archetype)
links.snippet: Truffle Hunters are fungomancers who have honed their skills in finding and utilizing rare and potent fungi. They often serve as scouts, foragers, or alchemists, prized for their ability to locate and identify valuable fungal specimens.

links.title: Fey Prankster (Jester Archetype)
links.snippet: Fey pranksters are jesters who have formed a deep connection with the chaotic and mischievous nature of the fey. They blend their jesting abilities with fey magic, becoming masters of illusion and trickery.

links.title: Vaudevillian Virtuoso (Jester Archetype)
links.snippet: Vaudevillian virtuosos are jesters who have honed their skills in the rough-and-tumble world of vaudeville entertainment. They excel at improvisation and quick- thinking, using their wit and charm to survive in any situation.

links.title: Ancestor Channeler (Nganga Archetype)
links.snippet: Ancestor Channelers focus on deepening their connection with specific ancestral spirits, allowing them to call upon their power more directly. These Nganga specialize in communing with and embodying the spirits of their ancestors, gaining…

links.title: Spirit Dancer (Nganga Archetype)
links.snippet: Spirit Dancers are Nganga who have mastered the art of communicating with spirits through intricate dances and rituals. They excel at manipulating spiritual energies and can call upon multiple spirits simultaneously to enhance their…

links.title: Chameleon (Shadow Archetype)
links.snippet: Chameleons are Shadows who have mastered the art of blending seamlessly into any environment. They excel at adapting to their surroundings, becoming nearly impossible to detect in both urban and natural settings.

links.title: Wilderness Ghost (Shadow Archetype)
links.snippet: Wilderness Ghosts are Shadows who have honed their skills to survive and thrive in the harshest natural environments. They become one with nature, capable of enduring extreme conditions and moving unseen through any terrain.

links.title: Automaton Engineer (Tinkerer Archetype)
links.snippet: Automaton Engineers specialize in creating semi- autonomous machines that can assist them in various tasks. These tinkerers focus on developing complex mechanisms that can perform actions with minimal supervision.

links.title: Energetic Innovator (Tinkerer Archetype)
links.snippet: Energetic Innovators specialize in harnessing and manipulating various forms of energy. They excel at creating devices that generate, store, and unleash powerful energy effects.

links.title: Probability Manipulator (Tinkerer Archetype)
links.snippet: Probability Manipulators are tinkerers who delve into the realm of quantum mechanics and chaos theory. They create devices that can alter the fabric of reality and manipulate probabilities.

links.title: Temporal Technician (Tinkerer Archetype)
links.snippet: Temporal Technicians are tinkerers who have unlocked the secrets of manipulating time itself. Their inventions can speed up allies, slow down enemies, or even create localized time distortions.

links.snippet: Effect : The companion’s strikes are augmented with energy. The vanguard must choose one of the following weapon properties: corrosive , flaming , frost , or shock . The companion’s natural attacks and weapon attacks are treated as having…

links.title: Extradimensional Arsenal (Su)
links.snippet: Effect : The companion gains an extradimensional storage space within its body. This functions as a bag of holding type I . The companion can draw items from the space as a move action . It can allow others to reach into the space to…

links.title: Mending Touch (Sp)
links.snippet: Prerequisite : None (automatically gained at 1st level)

links.title: Mental Link (Su)
links.snippet: Effect : The companion forms a magical link between itself and the vanguard, allowing them to communicate telepathically. This functions out to any range, including through walls, so long as the companion is not shut down.

links.title: Munitions Generation (Sp)

links.title: Tactical Reposition (Su)

links.title: Weapon Empowerment (Su)
links.snippet: Effect : The companion’s weapons are filled with magical energy. All natural attacks and weapon attacks made by the companion are treated as magic for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction . At 7th level, the weapons are treated as…

links.title: Chakravartin (Fisherking Archetype)
links.snippet: While most fisherkings are merely sovereigns of their own domains, an exalted few are more akin to a cogwheel of the cosmos’ celestial machinery. Chakravartin are wise fisherkings who have yoked the might of the heavens to their will, and…

links.title: King of Misrule (Fisherking Archetype)
links.snippet: For a season even a commoner can become a king, and at such times they can turn order and reason upside down.

links.title: Archetypes
links.snippet: Archetypes

links.title: Scholar Studies
links.snippet: Scholar Studies

links.title: Ancestor Caller
links.snippet: Shamans of warrior tribes bond with the spirits of late fighters, which accompany their fellows in battle.

links.title: Houngan
links.snippet: The houngan is nearer than other shamans to otherworldly and divine forces, yet even a houngan doesn’t fully understand these forces. This shaman keeps in contact with the world of the dead, delivering messages and seeking advice–and…

links.title: Plant Shaman
links.snippet: The plant shaman is a solitary, strange figure gifted with unusual powers linked to the vegetable world.

links.title: Abjurant Crusade (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a land of magic-wielding knights whose mastery of abjuration has been put to good use protecting its citizens and allies.

links.title: Fjords of Ice (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a land where the bitter cold of the frozen rivers serves to empower its champions with powerful frost magic.

links.title: Flickering Blossom (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a land infused with positive energy, where the plants grow tall and shed blossoms year-round.

links.title: Land of the Sighted (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a land of diviners that use their gift of sight to find their foe’s weaknesses and the best routes towards leading their people.

links.title: Necromantic Hold (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a land where necromancy is used to keep your warriors fighting, their fury stopping for none, not even death.

links.title: Sands of Flame (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a desert land where fiery magic is seen as a mark of greatness, spurring those in search of power to master flames.

links.title: Umbral Wood (Imperial Origin)
links.snippet: You are from a dark forest, where shadowed magic and vile druids are the norm.

links.title: Ballistic Mage (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Although most legendary arcanists have some martial training, a few have achieved synergy between spell and weapon. This synergy allows the legendary arcanist to deliver spells with aerodynamic flair.

links.title: Bedeviling Blade (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Magic is a great tool, but often it’s easier just to be a sneaky bastard. Subtlety has its own advantages.

links.title: Black Blade Adept (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Like many magi, there are legendary arcanists who come into possession of a black blade, a sentient weapon bound to serve the adept.

links.title: Blood Arcanist (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Like a sorcerer, the legendary arcanist has something in their blood that gives them their power. Although diluted, some have shown more potential.

links.title: Dracomancer (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Dragons represent the ultimate in arcane power. The dracomancer doesn’t just learn about dragons, but also channels their power directly into their body.

links.title: Drake Rider (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Dragons are naturally magical, so coveting their power is only rational.

links.title: Inspired Arcanist (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: Knowledge is power. That’s what wizards say. They are almost right: secrets are power.

links.title: Theurge (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
links.snippet: The theurge studies the magic power of the divine.

links.title: Draconic Avenger
links.snippet: For certain cavaliers, things such as horses are less than useful for their goals. Draconic Avengers seek to align themselves with far more powerful creatures, forming bonds with mighty drakes.

links.title: Dreadnaught
links.snippet: Many cavaliers rely on their mount to afford them protection and stature on the battlefield. Dreadnaughts turn to their armor for these advantages, trusting steel above another creature’s sinew.

links.title: Firearm Soldier
links.snippet: Masters of black powder and danger, firearm soldiers have perfected the art of using these dangerous weapons astride powerful mounts, raining death from a distance.

links.title: Houndmaster
links.snippet: The noble art of hunting runs deep in the history of cavaliers.

links.title: Iron General
links.snippet: Those who lead often do so at the forefront of combat, foregoing weapons in a display of pure martial prowess to inspire all those who witness it.

links.title: Jungle Rider
links.snippet: Jungle riders tame the beasts and creatures of the jungles to serve as their steeds. These exotic mounts serve the cavaliers well and are often more vicious than their riders.

links.title: Marrow Lancer
links.snippet: Cavaliers are often pledged to a noble master or cause, finding rewards and prestige from such association and service.

links.title: Masked Traveler
links.snippet: Legendary cavaliers tend to work best in the open, but there are those who understand that secrecy is paramount to their goals. Masked travelers allow their tales to be told around the land, only surfacing to accomplish their missions.

links.title: Mounted Champion (Legendary Cavalier Archetype)
links.snippet: The power of legendary cavaliers takes many forms, and there are those who enter combat with a variety of techniques at their beck and call. Mounted champions stride into combat with pride, knowing that theirs is an order that cannot be…

links.title: Pegasus Knight
links.snippet: With horses ruling the ground below, pegasus knights instead seek to rule the skies above. Elegant riders in the air pegasus knights patrol above others, their mounts serving to help them gain the advantage against groundborne foes.

links.title: Severed Limbs
links.snippet: If you remove a wing, the target loses a wing natural attack if it had any and cannot ?y (creatures with 3 or more wings who lose a wing have their ?ight maneuverability reduced to clumsy and have their flight speed reduced by 1/2 for each…

links.title: Steppe Rider (Legendary Cavalier Archetype)
links.snippet: Not every cavalier lives for the thrill of the charge and the impact of the enemy on their lance. Some prefer to use their mount’s speed to keep out of reach and strike like lightning.

links.title: Legendary Order of Fate
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order is one with little direction in their life, allowing the winds of fate to guide them as they may travel.

links.title: Legendary Order of No Quarter
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order is not capable of showing mercy or concern for others, placing their own survival and honor above all else.

links.title: Legendary Order of Nobility
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order works to uphold the standards and nobility of royalty, aiming to make themselves a paragon of honor.

links.title: Legendary Order of the Beyond
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order follows principles far past normal understanding, drawing inspiration from the planes and those who dwell within.

links.title: Legendary Order of the Fallen
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order is dedicated to service of those who have come before them. They are dedicated to the respect of the dead, striving to keep the memory of those lost alive.

links.title: Legendary Order of the Green
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order is dedicated to nature in all her many forms. They respect the beauty in the songbird and the strength in the old oak. Their goal is for all to find their place in the natural order.

links.title: Legendary Order of the Scorpion
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order cares only for themselves and their own personal glory, seeking out challenges to raise their own standing.

links.title: Legendary Order of the Shadow
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order works from behind the scenes, accomplishing their goals without being seen, with some not even believing this order exists.

links.title: Legendary Order of the Tome
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order pledges themselves as a servant of arcane spellcasters, often serving as their assistants and bodyguards.

links.title: Legendary Order of Unity
links.snippet: A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order is one who is dedicated to a smaller collection of individuals, valuing personal connections above all else.

links.title: Amoralist (Legendary Druid Archetype)
links.snippet: The legendary druid’s first allegiance is to the force of nature, not any ethos and certainly not to any deity. A legendary druid does not worship any god and does not ascribe to their notions of good and evil.

links.title: Midnight Carnivore (Legendary Druid Archetype)
links.snippet: Death is a part of nature, as almost every creature is preyed upon and eaten by others. Legendary druids accept this truth, and some druids go as far as studying the methods of hunting beasts.

links.title: Moon Child (Legendary Druid Archetype)
links.snippet: A child born under the right signs can be touched with their own unique connection to the primal world. They are the chosen of nature who will make nature’s will their own.

links.title: Oaken Soul (Legendary Druid Archetype)
links.snippet: Trees are not only nourished by water, soil, and sun. They are also nourished by the forces of life itself: love, beauty, laughter, passion, and the many things that living creatures experience. The oak, in particular, is fed by wisdom,…

links.title: Servant of the Unknown (Legendary Druid Archetype)
links.snippet: There are unknown forces in nature with their own goals and their own servants. They call to those who will worship them and empower them in their own unique way.

links.title: Circle of Crawling (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: The most numerous members of nature’s domain are those noticed the least: those that crawl and hide and dig. But without them, nothing else would survive.

links.title: Circle of Dust (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: Everything ends; it is the way of things.

links.title: Circle of Earth (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: You have mastery over earth, metal, and stone, can fire darts of acid, and command earth creatures.

links.title: Circle of Fauna (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: You draw power from the living creatures and animals of the world.

links.title: Circle of Flora (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: You share a love of all things that grow and show great respect for the verdant spaces of the world whether they be remote jungle valleys or stubborn growths among city streets.

links.title: Circle of Healing (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: Your touch staves off pain and death, and your healing magic is particularly vital and potent.

links.title: Circle of Iron (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: A connection to iron is one of strength, fortitude and protection, of oneself and one’s allies.

links.title: Circle of Savagery (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: In strength and brawn there is truth-your faith gives you incredible might and power.

links.title: Circle of Summoning (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: Bonus Spells : summon nature’s ally I (1st), summon nature’s ally II (2nd), summon nature’s ally III (3rd), summon nature’s ally IV (4th), summon nature’s ally V (5th), summon nature’s ally VI (6th). summon nature’s ally VII (7th), summon…

links.title: Circle of the Hearth (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: A fire contained within a circle of stones is all it takes to bring nature’s power under your command.

links.title: Circle of the Ocean (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: Your heart belongs to the fathomless reaches beneath the waves.

links.title: Circle of the Sky (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: You are one with the winds and charged storms that circle the skies. You bring the wrath of the skies to bear on those below.

links.title: Circle of the Sun (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: You see truth in the pure and burning light of the sun, and can call upon its blessing or wrath to work great deeds.

links.title: Circle of Winter (Druid Circle)
links.snippet: You draw power from the cold, dark places of the world. The cold and darkness are your friends.

links.title: Legendary Fighter Simple Archetypes
links.snippet: The following archetypes only replace a small amount of the fighter’s class features, allowing them to fill in small gaps in their set of abilities to complete a specific concept.

links.title: Brave Saint (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: It’s easy to laugh in the face of death when you believe in the certain and unavoidable victory of your god. The brave saint spreads the word by winning duels, achieving amazing deeds and swaying the hearts and minds of infidels with her…

links.title: Congregational Advocate (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Adventuring can be a messy business. Often, a company of adventurers will break laws, taboos, and the occasional skull in their pursuit of fame and glory. To safeguard themselves from these unfortunate eventualities, an adventuring party…

links.title: Conquistador (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Armed with steel and clad for war, conquistadors seek conquest over large territories. With their deity as their ally, they claim lands and entire peoples as their fiefs to rule over. Rare is the conquistador who desires peace, for they…

links.title: Dread Inquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Ordained with grim authority, dread inquisitors take an active role in confronting those who challenge their right to govern. By arriving unannounced, they strike fear into their enemies with the element of surprise.

links.title: Enlightened Vindicator (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: An inquisitor can choose to walk the path of martial tactics, or the path of inspired magic. Those choosing the latter can learn deeper secrets of divine power to directly destroy their enemies.

links.title: Exquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Selected among the “choicest” candidates, exquisitors use charm and social grace to conduct their inquiries. Although sweet instead of stern, they are no less ruthless than their grim counterparts.

links.title: Favored Wielder (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: As a symbolic expression of their religious devotion, some inquisitors train with the favored weapon of their god to an obsessive degree. Achieving an uncanny mastery with this weapon, a favored wielder greets every combat situation with…

links.title: Godsibb (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: It is good to have a priest in the family. Godsibbs are localized inquisitors who assert dominance over a community by controlling the flow of information and misinformation.

links.title: Hound of God (Skinwalker Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Being a lycanthrope, or having lycanthropic blood, is not necessarily a bad thing. According to some, the deities of night and protection chose these creatures to be the bridge between realms of existence, and protect their flock from…

links.title: Ink Wizarder (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Many wizard organizations are structured like religions, with rules, customs, and protocols dictating the actions and decisions of these magical factions. Such wizardly orders often police their own by training and employing “ink…

links.title: Inquasitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Some people acquire so much sin that it must be purged and given a form by which it can be controlled. Inquasitors endeavor to avoid damnation by extracting the evil in their souls in a self-inflicted exorcism. The result is a quasit…

links.title: Inquestor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: When the religious protocols of an inquisition fail to bring results, a secular inquest can be made to fill in the gaps of the inquiry. Inquestors employ the mundane techniques of investigators to get the answers they need. Armed with…

links.title: Lombard (Dwarf Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Lombards (Long-beards) are religious bankers who guide civilizations through the manipulation of wealth. As borrowers and lenders, they broker deals with friends and enemies alike in order to pave the way to progress. Woe to those who fail…

links.title: Monastic Enforcer (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: The mastery of martial arts can lead down many different paths of power. Yet, some of these paths are forbidden. Enter the monastic enforcer. Trained to protect the secrets of their monastery and to punish its wayward students, monastic…

links.title: Peacekeeper (Aasimar Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: A peacekeeper strives to defend her allies and maintain peace among opposite factions, converting and redeeming enemies and offering her judgment to come to a resolution without the use of violence.

links.title: Postquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Sometimes the stink of sin is too faint for the most astute inquisitors to detect. Guided by trained animals, postquisitors are the “ones who follow after” in the pursuit of preserving the faith at large. In return for their faithful…

links.title: Prerequisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Religious faith and a strong will are not the only components of wisdom. There is also practical pragmatism. Prerequisitors trust in their own awareness of things when learning something new in order to improve themselves. When her…

links.title: Requisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: “A swift grift is a thrifty gift”. Such is a phrase often uttered by requisitors. To achieve their ends, a requisitor justifies theft and robbery by portraying such actions as religious protocols and lawful procedures, even if they might…

links.title: Retroquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: The key to the future is understanding the past. While still fully committed to their religion, retroquisitors are fanatical devotees of learning, particularly in matters of history and languages. Lifelong students of lore, retroquisitors…

links.title: Sequisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: When all that is false and misleading crumbles, the truth will remain standing strong. Sequisitors ask theological questions with the rhetorical intention to destroy opposing faiths. Masters of religious debate, sequisitors probe the…

links.title: Viceregent (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Vicegerents are inquisitors who preach their faith to the public. By telling parables related to their religion and philosophy, vicegerents inspire their allies in glorious ways.

links.title: Wretched Inquisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: Some inquisitors are not formally trained by their churches, but rather cruelly twisted by their enemies. At some point in her life, a wretched legendary inquisitor had been captured, imprisoned, and tortured for an extended period of…

links.title: Xarol (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
links.snippet: When nature is threatened, who will speak for it? Xarols use druidic magic to communicate with the beasts of the wilderness and the wilderness itself. By gleaning information from these primal sources they learn exactly who they must pass…

links.title: Gadgeteer
links.snippet: Technology can work wonders and the gadgeteer leverages cush wonders in their endeavors by creating fantastic gadgets that can aid them in the various tasks required for their investigations.

links.title: Maverick Detective
links.snippet: All investigators believe in careful planning; some just prefer to do it after the fact. Rather than carefully analyzing a situation, the maverick detective prefers to jump in and figure it out as they go.

links.title: Two-Fisted Detective
links.snippet: Proficiencies : Two-fisted detectives are proficient with simple weapons, as well as light armor and bucklers. In addition, if this is this character’s first level in any class, they may select a martial tradition of their choice.

links.title: Blade of Legend (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: A small sect of magi go further than mastering blade and spell: they marry the two into a sentient weapon. These blackblades assist their masters with their goals but may not be the mere tools they seem.

links.title: Coiled Viper (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: The order of the coiled viper is secretive order of magi that specialize in poisons and debilitating their foes with both magic and their iconic weapon of choice: the whip.

links.title: Dragon Fang (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: Many legendary magi study hard to learn the secrets of their tomes, while a rare few are naturally gifted in the arcane thanks to a draconic source.

links.title: Drakeguard (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: This rare sect of magi form a magical bond with an egg of an unhatched drake , bolstering its unborn body with their inner magical potential.

links.title: First Magus (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: The modern magus studies the arcane and trains in manufactured weapons, but some are of an older philosophy.

links.title: Hexwielder (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: A hexwielder magus has learned to use their arcane potential to curse their foes with debilitating hexes . These dark magi can wield devastating curses of all kinds, expanding their selection of spells and arcana..

links.title: Legendary Kensai (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: A legendary kensai has spent his life honing both his physical and magical training towards the art of mastering a single weapon, using his arcane potential and martial prowess to become a paragon amongst warriors.

links.title: Ruinous Blade (Legendary Magus Archetype)

links.title: Spellstriker (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: Spellstriker magi have learned to channel their spells through their weapons to deliver devastating simultaneous strikes at the cost of continually empowering their weapons in combat.

links.title: War Scholar (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: A war scholar has forgone some of their magical ability to study the martial arts known as spheres in an effort to bolster and augment their warrior training.

links.title: Warp Tempest (Legendary Magus Archetype)
links.snippet: These rare warriors have learned to travel within the space between realities, instantly blinking from place to place in a tempest of blade and sorcery.

links.title: Holy Questioner (Legendary Paladin Archetype)

links.title: Questor (Legendary Paladin Archetype)
links.snippet: A questor may have begun as an legendary inquisitor and then become aware that her deity called her to different battles, or she can be a normal paladin who realized that sometimes the clenched fist is needed against evil.

links.title: Verdant Knight (Legendary Paladin Archetype)

links.title: Winter Knight (Legendary Paladin Archetype)
links.snippet: In frigid regions, paladins must adapt to local conditions.

links.snippet: The rogue must take the poisoner skill specialty as her first skill specialty.

links.snippet: A sanctified rogue adds Knowledge (religion) to her class skills instead of Knowledge (dungeoneering).

links.title: Daring Infiltrator (Legendary Swashbuckler Archetype)
